1|# Global Visual & Sensory Cohesion Standard (Master Tracker #1774)
2|
3|**Owner directive (Ryan, Nov 22 2026):**
4|> "make sure we're not just doing individual patches but taking a more global approach? And then include everything we've discussed"
5|
6|This document establishes **one unified visual, material, world, and audio contract** across the entire game so subsystems stop drifting in silos. Every ship exterior, ship interior, weapon effect, combat wound, destruction sequence, graveyard hulk, debris hex, station, planet, asteroid, crystal cluster, space sky, and audio cue derives from the same grounded sci-fi hierarchy and is protected by automated anti-drift gates.
7|
8|**Companion specs unified under this standard:**
9|- **R416 Cohesive Ship-to-Destruction Pipeline:** `contrib/opus/plans/cohesive_damage_v2.md` (`#1741` Wounds V2 Layers 1+2, `#1743` / PR `#1763` Interior Kit V2 Layer 3, `#1692` weapon marks, `#1422` / `#1681` / `#1684` active rebakes).
10|- **R419 World & Backdrop Consistency V2:** `contrib/opus/plans/world_consistency_v2.md` (`#1764` tracker, `#1765` / `#1463` Planets V2, `#1361` Asteroids & Crystals V2, `#1766` / `#1502` / `#1328` Grounded Cinematic Space Sky & Dead Star Seam, `#1767` / `#1362` Stations, Hulks & R416 Wreckage).
11|- **Cohesive Dark Sci-Fi Audio V2:** `contrib/opus/plans/cohesive_audio_v2.md` (`#1752`, PR `#1753`, Ryan picks locked `1=A, 2=A, 3=A`, 72 items / 138 files, Wave A first after `main` merge confirmation).
12|
13|---
14|
15|## 1. Why Silo Patches Kept Breaking Cohesion
16|
17|Independent audits across the entire game exposed **one repeating structural failure** across every visual and audio pipeline:
18|
19|1. **No shared value / luminance budget:** Grounded dark-space hulls sit at `0.04` to `0.15` linear albedo, yet Directorate interiors jumped to matte pale clay (`0.175` linear, `metal 0.2`, `var 0.05`, 2.5x to 6x brighter than every other metal faction), old `O1_37` stations stayed chalk-white, and `world_sky.gd` painted ~85,000 bright 2px stars (~6,800 to 11,600 per frame) behind the fleet.
20|2. **Schematic blockout colors leaked into final renders:** `tools/blender/build_sheets/kit.py` lines 54 to 105 carry early CAD/diagram room colors (`engroom` orange, `magazine` red, `hangar` blue, `crew` green, `bridge` yellow, Eclipse `archive` teal-green, Chorus `vat` neon lime emitting `2.0`, `gland` acid yellow-green emitting `0.6`, `brood` bright yellow). PR `#1763` raised `INSIDE_TINT` from `0.18` to `0.55` and passed Chorus schematic colors and full-surface emissions straight into final V2 materials, turning Chorus organs into neon green/yellow lightbulbs, binding bone hoops (`bonefr`) to wet glowing flesh trim, leaking teal-green `archive` tint into Eclipse, and tinting metal rooms like a color-coded cutaway diagram.
21|3. **Unenforced hue / palette rules:** RULEBOOK 10.9 banned indigo-to-purple gradients on battle nebulas, yet `PLANETS[2]` stayed a cartoon purple gas giant, Eclipse kept purple `[0.34, 0.14, 0.52]` in `godot/fx/faction_looks.json:102`, `nebula_crystal_belt` turned yellow-mustard soup, and Chorus interiors turned neon lime.
22|4. **Asset fidelity mismatches & silent wiring gaps:** 39.7 MB of 8K NASA `R01` rocky planet maps sat completely unwired in git while `board.gd` rendered a blurry campaign-icon sphere; crushed `COLOR_0.b` (`facet`) channels on `scan_00..05` plus a blanket warm-tan tint collapsed all 5 asteroid biomes to identical tan stone; 216-tri flat cyan crystal spikes sat on 90K-tri boulders; `station_T2` was gated strictly to `size == 46.0` leaving chalky `O1_37` on smaller clusters; `board.gd:_hulk()` skipped Chorus and Glasswrights completely; and old `wreck_kit.py` trusses clashed against detailed hulls.
23|5. **Isolated review views:** Interiors were tuned in Blender without `#1741`'s dynamic breach cavity lights (`s._hole_lights`), skies were tuned without judging full-frame 1080p ship readability, and Gate 1 audio prompts were written without checking Godot's per-muzzle trigger loop.
24|
25|**Rule going forward:** No subsystem is tuned or patched in isolation. Every change must satisfy the five global laws below and pass the automated anti-drift gates in Section 6.
26|
27|---
28|
29|## 2. Law 1: Global Value & Luminance Hierarchy
30|
31|Every visual element in a battle frame belongs to one strict luminance band so silhouettes, depth, and tactical clarity never fight each other:
32|
33|| Band | Target Linear Albedo / Luminance | Role & Hard Rules |
34|| :--- | :--- | :--- |
35|| **1. Deep Space Void** | 0.00 to 0.015 (near-black) | Majority of the sky frame (`#1766`, RULEBOOK 10.11). Calm dark negative space so ships, hex lines, and weapon fire read effortlessly. |
36|| **2. Cosmic Landmarks & Backdrop Planets** | 0.03 to 0.25 (terminator shadow near 0) | Milky Way band carved by opaque dust rifts (`star_floor = 0.0`), restrained non-purple/non-mustard regional nebula, 16-bit band-free bake (`#1502`), realistic planets and moons matching A-tier ringed gas giants (`#1765`). |
37|| **3. Lit Outer Hulls, Stations & Asteroids** | 0.04 to 0.30 linear base (15 to 55% shaded lit faces) | Physically grounded PBR armor, `station_T2` across all sizes (`#1767`), distinct 5-biome asteroids and faceted multi-crystal clusters (`#1361`), 6-faction hulks & ship-kit debris (`#1767`, `#1362`). |
38|| **4. Shadowed Ship Interiors & Wreckage Cavities** | **Strictly darker than lit outer armor: 0.03 to 0.10 linear mean max** (bone/glass structural trim exempted up to 0.18 matte/refractive) | Broken-open compartments sit in deep vacuum shadow, NEVER stark matte chalk-white (`0.175`) and NEVER rainbow diagram colors. Mood and readability come from modeled ribs/machinery, crisp normal/AO relief, thin recessed accent light strips, and `#1741` Layer 1 dynamic breach cavity lights. |
39|| **5. Emissives, Weapons, Cores & Breach Arcs** | Reserved HDR top band (localized only) | Muzzle flashes, beams, projectiles, reactor cores, engine throats, shield flares, and tiny recessed interior light strips or gland pores. **Never** full-surface glowing organs (`vat 2.0`), full-wall neon, or wall-to-wall starfield static. |
40|
41|---
42|
43|## 3. Law 2: Global Fix for Modeled Ship Interiors (PR #1763 / #1743 + #1741)
44|
45|Instead of patching individual faction colors after each cutaway review, PR `#1763` (`#1743`) must enforce one global material architecture across **all 6 factions**:
46|
47|1. **Decouple `inside_material()` from `kit.py` schematic blockout colors completely:**
48|   - `kit.py` lines 54 to 105 (`engroom`, `magazine`, `machinery`, `hangar`, `crew`, `bridge`, `archive`, `organ`, `gut`, `gland`, `brood`, `vat`, `ganglion`, `septum`, `bonefr`) are **semantic role tags ONLY**.
49|   - `inside_material(room, trim=True)` in EVERY faction `stack.py` MUST ignore `kit.py`'s schematic `Base Color` and non-core `Emission Strength`. Instead, map each room/part role through that faction's **authored interior role table** (`wall`, `deck`, `frame`, `machinery`, `core`, `organ`, `bone`, `gland`, `glass_strut`).
50|   - Room differentiation comes from **modeled architecture** (`interior_kit.py`), **roughness/metal/panel variation**, **subtle micro-tint (`<= 15%` shift within the faction's own grounded palette)**, and **localized accent lights**, NEVER from orange/red/blue/green/yellow CAD color-coding.
51|2. **Strict Structural-vs-Surface Separation:**
52|   - Structural frames (`bonefr`, `frame`, `truss`, `bulkhead`, `deck`) MUST take structural finishes (dry weathered bone on Chorus, dark brushed alloy on metal factions, faceted clear/tinted struts on Glasswrights). Never apply wet glowing flesh trim to Chorus bone hoops/struts.
53|3. **Coordinated Six-Faction Interior Calibration (Jointly with `#1741` Layer 1 Breach Lights):**
54|   - **Sunward Crusade (`voidsworn`):** Dark forged-iron bulkheads (`~0.045 to 0.065` linear, `metal 0.35..0.5`), subtle ash/carbon panel contrast, restrained warm ember recessed strips (`strength <= 1.5`), hot reactor core slits only.
55|   - **Meridian Directorate (`hegemony`):** **Cool brushed clinical steel-slate (`~0.075 to 0.095` linear, `metal 0.45`, `var 0.10`, low grime `0.10`)**: noticeably cleaner, cooler, and slightly lighter than Sunward/Hullbreakers without ever looking like stark chalky white clay (`0.175` matte is retired). Crisp cold-blue emergency strips carry the sterile Directorate identity.
56|   - **Ashfall Hullbreakers (`corsair`):** Dark oil-stained scavenged steel (`~0.045 to 0.065` linear, mismatched plates, rust/soot pockets unique to Hullbreakers), sparse dim red-orange cage lamps (`strength <= 1.1`).
57|   - **The Chorus (`chorus`):** Deep wet dark crimson-umber / bruised mahogany organic cavity tissue (`~0.035 to 0.075` linear, wet roughness `0.24..0.46`, zero metal, zero magenta, **zero bright yellow `flesh_tone`/`brood` and zero neon lime `vat`/`gland` full-surface glow**). `bonefr` hoops and cross-struts use **dry weathered muted ochre-ivory bone** (`~0.14 to 0.18` linear, roughness `0.60..0.72`, zero glow). Any bioluminescent bile accent stays strictly tiny, deep, and muted (dim olive-amber capillary pores inside gland/vat recesses only, `strength <= 0.25`, `share <= 0.08`).
58|   - **The Glasswrights (`ithar`):** Deep translucent-reading annealed seafoam/smoky-amber faceted crystal bulkheads (`~0.05 to 0.10` linear, low roughness `0.08..0.28`, zero metal, zero soot, zero grime), subtle seafoam edge-refraction highlights (`strength <= 0.6`), luminous crystal prism core nodes only.
59|   - **Eclipse (`deathless`):** Deep obsidian-violet monolithic vaults (`~0.025 to 0.045` linear, satin dark alloy/obsidian `rough 0.28..0.55`, **zero green from `archive` or `ecore`**, zero rust), hairline violet-white power bus rails (`faction_looks.json` `death.fire`, `strength <= 1.6`).
60|4. **Merge Order Guard (Artoo finding on PR `#1763`):** Resolve and land `#1724`'s `export7.py` map-size reporting fix cleanly before merging `#1763`, so reference rebakes report true pixel dimensions.
61|

70|| **Sunward Crusade (`voidsworn`)** | Forged dark iron + brass; ember-lit iron decks | Heavy forged-iron kinetic/propellant shell cannons, lances, torpedoes | Bent steel ribs, burning amber slag, soot & spark plumes | Jammed slot casemates/turrets, failing ember drive nozzles, ember core split | `V15_37` hulks + iron-kit burnt debris with R416 interior cuts | **1=A:** Forged-iron propellant shell crack + low thump; weathered low brass & cellos |

79|## 5. Law 4: World, Planets, Asteroids, Sky & Audio Integration
80|
81|All world and audio tracks operate under the exact same cohesion rules (full line-level specs in `contrib/opus/plans/world_consistency_v2.md` and `contrib/opus/plans/cohesive_audio_v2.md`):
82|
83|1. **Planets V2 (`#1765`, coordinated with `#1463`):**
84|   - Wire the unwired 39.7 MB 8K NASA `R01` rocky maps into `board.gd:_planet()` AND upgrade all 5 foreground `PLANET_LOOKS` off `map3d_shaders.gd`.
85|   - Re-palette cartoon purple `PLANETS[2]` (RULEBOOK 10.9), sharpen Terran (`PLANETS[3]`), Ice (`PLANETS[6]`), Barren (`PLANETS[5]` using remixed `R01` relief per RULEBOOK 10.3), and moons to match A-tier ringed gas giants (`PLANETS[0]`, `PLANETS[7]`).
86|2. **Asteroids & Crystals V2 (`#1361`):**
87|   - Fix crushed `COLOR_0.b` (`facet`) on `scan_00..05` so iron metal, ice frost, and crystal veins work on photogrammetry rocks.
88|   - Remove the blanket warm-tan tint (`world_rocks.gd:227`) from iron and carbon; restore biome shape variety in `names_for()`; retire flat boomerang `scan_07` and weak `scan_06`; replace 216-tri flat cyan `crystal_00..02.glb` spikes with faceted Blender multi-crystal clusters + `_lo` LODs.

94|   - Wait for PR `#1753` (72 items / 138 files, merge conflict resolved cleanly on `opus/issue-1752`) to merge and verify `main` holds the 72-item manifest before any spend.
95|   - Ryan's three picks are locked (`1=A` Sunward shell guns, `2=A` Eclipse heavy magnetic slam + cold hollow decay, `3=A` Gate 1 `reward_preview` wording on 16 whole bars).
96|   - Run Wave A (14 diagnostic items, `--max-credits 1200`) and ear-check on the corrected `listen_page.js` before Wave B (~4,300 real credits total).

100|## 6. Law 5: Automated Anti-Drift CI Gates (Stopping Regressions Forever)
101|
102|No visual rule stays intact if it relies on human memory alone. Add these automated checks directly into the existing pipelines:
103|
104|### 6.1 Blender Export & Material Gates (`tools/recipe/check_export.py` + `cutaway.py`)
105|1. **No Schematic Blockout Color Leak:** Fail export or test if any V2 interior material inherits unmapped `kit.py` schematic room hues/emissions (e.g., `vat 2.0`, `gland 0.6`, `archive` green on Eclipse, red `magazine`, blue `hangar`).
106|2. **Interior Albedo Ceiling Gate:** Compute mean linear base albedo of every non-bone, non-glass interior material; fail if `> 0.11` linear (automatically blocks chalky white `0.175` clay corridors from ever slipping back in).
107|3. **Interior Non-Core Emission Gate:** Fail if any non-core interior surface (outside `core` / `ecore` reactor slits) has full-surface constant emission `> 0.0` or area-weighted trim emission `> 0.25` (automatically blocks glowing neon-green Chorus organs).
108|4. **Faction Palette & Role Guard:**
109|   - Assert Chorus `bonefr` never binds to `style='flesh'` or any glowing vein emission.
110|   - Assert Chorus has zero metal (`metallic == 0.0`) and zero magenta/neon-lime saturation spikes.
111|   - Assert Glasswrights have zero soot/wear/metal.
112|   - Assert Eclipse has zero green (`g > r * 1.15 and g > b * 1.15` banned on both albedo and emission).
113|5. **Lossless Normal & ORM Map Gate (`#1778`):** Fail any ship export carrying lossy `.jpg` normal or ORM maps (lossless `.png` / BC5 only; fixes JPEG 8x8 plastic-smudge normals like `C19_51_normal.jpg` and `D21_23_normal.jpg`).
114|6. **Unified 6-Faction Lineup Review Sheet (`cutaway.py`):** Render one side-by-side 6-faction strip at identical exposure (showing exterior hull + cut-open interior for Sunward, Directorate, Hullbreakers, Chorus, Glasswrights, Eclipse together) AND require calibration against `#1741` Layer 1 breach cavity lights before locking final lift values.
115|
116|### 6.2 Godot Headless World, Exterior & Palette Parity Gates (`godot/world/test/`, `godot/render/`)
117|1. **Unwired-Asset Gate:** Assert `board.gd` wires high-relief planet shaders across all 5 `PLANET_LOOKS` (no silent fallback to `map3d_shaders.gd`), `a4_props.gd` uses `station_T2` across small and large clusters when installed, and `board.gd:_hulk()` covers all 6 factions.
118|2. **Ship Exterior Lighting & Micro-Detail Gate (`#1777`):** Assert Space PBR reflection IBL and per-faction `ao_light_affect` are enabled by default in play (not hidden behind an off-by-default env flag), `key.shadow_normal_bias <= 0.5`, and all 6 faction micro-detail normal/roughness maps resolve cleanly in `look.gd`.
119|3. **Rock Scan Channel Gate:** Inspect every rock `.glb` in `godot/world/rocks/scans.json` and assert `COLOR_0.b` spans usable dynamic range (`>= 0.45`) and minimum triangle quality (preventing flat/low-poly outlier regressions like `scan_07` and crushed `COLOR_0.b`).
120|4. **Zero-Purple & Starfield Budget Gate:** Assert zero indigo-to-purple entries in `world_sky.gd` (`PLANETS`, `PLANETS_ALT`) and `godot/fx/faction_looks.json` (`nebula`), and assert default `star_floor == 0.0` and grounded starfield thresholds in `world_sky.gd`.
121|
122|### 6.3 Audio Pack & Engine Gate (`contrib/opus/tools/sound/`, `#1752`)
123|- Keep automated `elevenlabs_gen_selftest.js` + manifest lint checking: one shot per wired SFX clip, zero naval/ocean/pink-elephant words, zero em dashes, exact `today` baseline mapping against `godot/audio/cues.json`, and `FAC_WNAMES` roster coverage.
124|- Gate 3 Godot wiring (`#1752`) uses Godot 4.7's native `AudioStreamSynchronized` / `AudioStreamInteractive` for beat-synced, bar-locked 4-stem adaptive battle music plus a dynamic `AudioEffectLowPassFilter` on `battle_sfx` during slow-motion death beats, tactical pause, and extreme zoom-out.
125|

128|## 7. Law 6: AAA Ship Exterior Lighting, Per-Faction Micro-Detail, PBR & Godot 4.7 Engine Standard (#1777, #1778, #1779, #1780)
129|
130|Visual and code audits of live in-game ship renders (`S9`, `S10`, `S8`, `H10`, `A16`, `C11`, `C14`, `E12`) vs accepted concepts proved that even newly built hulls read slightly clay-ish or miniature-like due to global Godot lighting defaults and mid-roughness/mid-metallic PBR values (`metal = 0.48`, `VS_FLEET_LIGHTING` off by default, `ao_light_affect = 0.0`, `shadow_normal_bias = 2.0`, `LookRim spec = 8.0`, zero tiling micro-detail normal/roughness layer, zero advanced PBR channels, hardcoded `600.0` shadow cascades, `COMPRESS_S3TC` normal compression bug in `build_assets.gd:159`, missing scale cues, and lossy `.jpg` normals on legacy hulls).
131|
132|### 7.1 Global Godot Ship Look, Advanced PBR Channels & Micro-Detail Layer (#1777, Lifts All 45 Ships Instantly)
133|1. **Default-On Multi-Lobe Space PBR Reflection IBL & `ao_light_affect`:** Graduate `#1679` ON by default in `godot/render/look.gd` and `godot/world/world.gd` with warm sun specular + cool nebula/planet bounce lobes + deep dark-space troughs, plus per-faction `ao_light_affect` so baked AO darkens sunlit seams and recesses.
134|2. **Crisp Contact Shadows & Zoom-Tracked Cascades (`look.gd:167`, `battle.gd:350,360`):** Reduce `key.shadow_normal_bias` from `2.0` down to a calibrated crisp contact-shadow range (`~0.15 to 0.35`), replace hardcoded `directional_shadow_max_distance = 600.0` with zoom-tracked `clampf(cam_r * 1.8, 120.0, 420.0)` and tighter near-split ratios (~3x sharper hull shadows for free), lower flat diffuse `ambient_light_energy` (`0.50` -> `~0.16 to 0.22`), and tame `LookRim` `spec: 8.0` plastic glare streaks across beveled decks.
135|3. **True BC5 / RGTC Ship Normal Compression (`godot/render/build_assets.gd:158-159`):** Fix the silent normal-map compression mismatch where line 156 asks for BC5/RGTC while line 159 passes `Image.COMPRESS_S3TC` (BC3 5-6-5 swizzled); switch to true `Image.COMPRESS_RGTC` (dual-8-bit normal precision) for cleaner specular highlights at identical VRAM size.
136|4. **Alive HDR Ship Emissives:** Push hot ship focal accents (Sunward ember spires, engine bells, core slits, Directorate bays, Eclipse corona rims) cleanly above bloom threshold (`0.8`) so vents glow warmly rather than reading as flat orange/blue paint stickers.
137|5. **Per-Faction Native Godot 4.7 PBR Channels (`BaseMaterial3D`) & Tiling Micro-Detail Maps (`godot/assets/ships/detail/`):** Inject six dedicated tileable micro-detail normal/roughness maps (mip-faded to prevent camera-170 shimmer) paired with native Godot 4.7 physical surface channels tailored per faction:
138|
139|| Faction | Godot Native PBR + Tiling Micro-Detail (#1777) | Blender Exterior PBR Separation & Scale Cues (#1778) |
140|| :--- | :--- | :--- |
141|| **Sunward Crusade (`voidsworn`)** | `anisotropy_enabled` rolled forged-iron highlight + rolled cast-iron micro-grain, weld seam pitting & carbon mottling | Raw forged dark iron (`metal 0.80..0.92`, varied `rough 0.25..0.50`) vs deep matte furnace soot crevices (`metal 0.0`, `rough 0.88`), brass fittings (`metal 0.92`), recessed hot ember spires + micro-porthole strips and stenciled markings |
142|| **Meridian Directorate (`hegemony`)** | `anisotropy_enabled` brushed titanium highlight + tight directional brushed aerospace alloy & micro-machined fastener grit | Satin coated clinical navy-slate (`metal 0.10..0.20`, `rough 0.36..0.52`) contrasting sharply with bare chipped/machined titanium edge wear (`metal 0.90`, `rough 0.20`), deep recessed armor seams, crisp fleet stripes & viewport rows |
143|| **Ashfall Hullbreakers (`corsair`)** | Coarse hammered/pitted salvage iron + rough oxidized rust crust & oil-streak micro-roughness breakup | Dark oil-streaked raw salvage iron base (`metal 0.72..0.88`) with localized weathered rust-red plates and matte rust crusts (`metal 0.0`, `rough 0.85..0.95`; pull back from uniform bright red plastic on `A16`), vent grates, weld scars & stencils |
144|| **The Chorus (`chorus`)** | `subsurf_scatter_enabled` + `backlight_enabled` (translucent warm rim glow through thin chitin/membranes/veils) + wet `clearcoat_enabled` + keratin striations & wet organic micro-pores (zero metal) | High-relief multi-scale keratin/scute grooves, porous bone ridges, wet mucosa crevice sheen (`rough 0.16..0.28`) vs dry chalky horn lips (`rough 0.58..0.74`, `metal 0.0`), eliminating smooth wax/play-doh close-ups (`C11`, `C14`) |
145|| **The Glasswrights (`ithar`)** | `refraction_enabled` + crystal `clearcoat_enabled` (bending background starlight and weapon beams through glass) + fine annealed crystal micro-facets & optical edge grain (zero metal, zero grime) | Deep refractive/reflective smoked seafoam & amber annealed glass (dark glassy internal depth + sharp Fresnel grazing mirror reflections + fine etched prism rings, replacing blinding white origami A4 hulls via `#1682` / `#1146`) |

70|### 4.1 Eight-Ray Footprint Validation (`BREACH.validate_footprint`)
71|Before finalizing any `K_HOLE` cutout or heavy mark of radius `R` at `(c, n)`:
72|1. Build tangent basis `(t1, t2)` around `n`.
73|2. Cast 8 perimeter rays from `c + radial_k * (0.85 * R) + n * (R * 0.9)` along `-n` against `hull.tm`.
74|3. A ray is valid if it hits within depth band `|dot(hit.p - c, n)| < max(R * 0.45, hull.L * 0.025)` and `hit.n.dot(n) > 0.30`.
75|4. If valid count < 6 (under 75% solid support):
76|   - Try shrinking `R` down in steps (`0.75 * R`, `0.55 * R`) and nudging `c` toward the average of valid hit points projected back onto `hull.tm`.
77|   - If still below threshold (or if `R < hull.L * 0.015`), downgrade `K_HOLE` to a **compact surface mark or edge-shear** instead of punching a hole over empty space.
78|5. **Thickness check for thin exterior structures (`_thick(hull, c, n, R)`):**
79|   - Cast center + 4 half-radius inward rays (`-n`) from just inside the skin.
80|   - If median hull thickness `< max(R * 0.40, hull.L * 0.018)` (e.g., Eclipse Zenith 0.14-thick outer shade ring arcs, dorsal fins, narrow struts), mark `e.thin_shear = true`: instead of cutting a deep interior cavity, cleanly delaminate/chip the outer plate layer (shallow recess + crisp structural frame/truss strip backing, zero floating cavity into open space).

+# the points of a node's mesh boxes (corners and points along every edge) that fall outside the pointy-top hexes of
+# corner radius `hex_r` round `cells` (board x, z); the debris field is left out (it drifts below the board by design)
+func _outside(n: Node3D, cells: Array, hex_r: float) -> int:
+	var bad := 0
+	var a := hex_r * sqrt(3.0) / 2.0
+	for mi in n.find_children("*", "MeshInstance3D", true, false):
+		if (mi as Node).get_parent().name == "station_T2_debris":
+			continue
+		var bb: AABB = (mi as MeshInstance3D).get_aabb()
+		var xf: Transform3D = (mi as Node3D).global_transform
+		for i in 8:
+			for j in 8:
+				if not [1, 2, 4].has(i ^ j) or j < i:
+					continue
+				for t in 9:
+					var p: Vector3 = xf * bb.get_endpoint(i).lerp(bb.get_endpoint(j), float(t) / 8.0)
+					var inside := false
+					for c in cells:
+						var dx := absf(p.x - (c as Vector2).x)
+						var dz := absf(p.z - (c as Vector2).y)
+						# a pointy-top hex (corners toward +z and -z): inside its flats and inside its slanted sides
+						if dx <= a + 1e-3 and dz + dx / sqrt(3.0) <= hex_r + 1e-3:
+							inside = true
+							break
+					if not inside:
+						bad += 1
+	return bad

diff --git a/godot/world/test/unwired_station_hulk_check.gd b/godot/world/test/unwired_station_hulk_check.gd
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..a91e1257d
--- /dev/null
+++ b/godot/world/test/unwired_station_hulk_check.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,157 @@
+extends SceneTree
+# R420 Law 5, gate 6.2 item 1 (contrib/opus/plans/global_cohesion_standard.md), the station and hulk half (issue 1767;
+# the planet half belongs to issue 1765): an approved asset must be reached by the live board, not only by a bench.
+#   station_T2: the real render/board.gd build puts T2 (not O1_37) on a small (3-hex) cluster, the big (19-hex) cluster
+#     and a station hole whenever T2 is installed (GitHub stands it in as a box with T2's bounds);
+#   hulks: A4P.HULKS names a hull for every faction in the rules FACTIONS table, every named code is a manifest ship of
+#     that faction, and the real board's _hulk() draws all six factions over a field of hulk hexes;
+#   band and identity: every faction's derelict finish keeps base albedo inside band 3 (0.04 to 0.30 linear), Eclipse
+#     hulks carry no green, Glasswright and Chorus hulks no metal soot.
+
+const GUARD := preload("res://tools/ci/check_guard.gd")
+const A4P := preload("res://assets/ships/a4_props.gd")
+const BOARD := preload("res://render/board.gd")
+const STUB := "res://render/test/fixtures/beacon/beacon_stub.tscn"
+const SOOT := Color(0.32, 0.29, 0.27)
+
+class StubRules extends RefCounted:
+	var v := {}
+	var w := {}
+	func view() -> Dictionary:
+		return v
+	func world_info() -> Dictionary:
+		return w
+
+var failures := 0
+var _keep: Array = []
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	GUARD.arm(self, "unwired_station_hulk_check")
+	process_frame.connect(_run, CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
+
+
+func _report(ok: bool, what: String) -> void:
+	print("%s: %s" % ["PASS" if ok else "FAIL", what])
+	if not ok:
+		failures += 1
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	if not ResourceLoader.exists(A4P.T2_PATH):
+		var node := Node3D.new()
+		var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+		var box := BoxMesh.new()
+		box.size = Vector3(99.2, 69.3, 70.2)
+		mi.mesh = box
+		node.add_child(mi)
+		mi.owner = node
+		var scene := PackedScene.new()
+		scene.pack(node)
+		node.free()
+		scene.take_over_path(A4P.T2_PATH)
+		_keep.append(scene)
+	var ships := {"O1_37": {"res": STUB}}
+	for fac in A4P.HULKS:
+		for code in A4P.HULKS[fac]:
+			ships[code] = {"res": STUB}
+	A4P._man = {"ships": ships}
+	_hulk_table()
+	_board_wiring()
+	_finishes()
+	_keep.clear()
+	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)
+
+
+func _hulk_table() -> void:
+	var tables: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://rules/data/tables.json"))
+	var facs: Dictionary = tables.get("tables", tables)["FACTIONS"]
+	var man: Dictionary = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://assets/ships/manifest.json"))
+	var rows: Dictionary = man.get("ships", man)
+	var missing: Array = []
+	var wrong: Array = []
+	for fac in facs:
+		if not A4P.HULKS.has(fac) or (A4P.HULKS[fac] as Array).is_empty():
+			missing.append(fac)
+	for fac in A4P.HULKS:
+		for code in A4P.HULKS[fac]:
+			if not rows.has(code) or str(rows[code].get("faction", "")) != fac:
+				wrong.append(code)
+	_report(missing.is_empty(), "A4P.HULKS names a hulk for every rules faction (missing: %s)" % str(missing))
+	_report(wrong.is_empty(), "every hulk code is a manifest ship of its faction (wrong: %s)" % str(wrong))
+
+
+func _board(terrain: Dictionary, holes: Array, map: Dictionary, radius: int) -> Node3D:
+	var hexes := []
+	for q in range(-radius, radius + 1):
+		for r in range(-radius, radius + 1):
+			if absi(q + r) <= radius:
+				hexes.append({"q": q, "r": r})
+	var m := map.duplicate()
+	m["holes"] = holes
+	var rules := StubRules.new()
+	rules.v = {"hexes": hexes, "terrain": terrain, "units": [], "map": m}
+	rules.w = {"seed": 11, "biome": {"rock": "stone", "planet": 0, "station": "rig"}}
+	var board: Node3D = BOARD.new()
+	root.add_child(board)
+	board.build(rules)
+	return board
+
+
+func _count(board: Node3D, meta: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {}
+	for n in board.find_children("*", "Node3D", true, false):
+		if n.has_meta(meta):
+			var k := str(n.get_meta(meta))
+			out[k] = int(out.get(k, 0)) + 1
+	return out
+
+
+func _board_wiring() -> void:
+	var small := _board({"0,0": "station", "1,0": "station", "0,1": "station"}, [{"kind": "station", "cells": [[4, -2]]}],
+		{"station": {"q": 0, "r": 0}, "stationR": 1}, 6)
+	var t2 := _count(small, "station_T2")
+	var o1 := small.find_children("*", "", true, false).filter(func(n): return n.has_meta("station_kind") and not n.has_meta("station_T2"))
+	_report(int(t2.get("true", 0)) == 2 and o1.is_empty(), "a small cluster and a station hole both get station_T2, no O1_37 (%s)" % str(t2))
+	small.free()
+	var big := {}
+	for q in range(-2, 3):
+		for r in range(-2, 3):
+			if absi(q + r) <= 2:
+				big["%d,%d" % [q, r]] = "station"
+	var b2 := _board(big, [], {"station": {"q": 0, "r": 0}, "stationR": 2}, 6)
+	_report(int(_count(b2, "station_T2").get("true", 0)) == 1, "the big cluster gets station_T2")
+	b2.free()
+	# a field of hulk hexes with no units (no local faction): the draw must reach every faction
+	var field := {}
+	for q in range(-6, 7):
+		for r in range(-6, 7):
+			if absi(q + r) <= 6 and (q * 7 + r * 3) % 4 == 0:
+				field["%d,%d" % [q, r]] = "hulk"
+	var b3 := _board(field, [], {}, 7)
+	var got := _count(b3, "hulk_faction")
+	_report(got.size() == 6, "the live _hulk() draws all six factions over %d hulk hexes: %s" % [field.size(), str(got)])
+	b3.free()
+
+
+func _finishes() -> void:
+	# a bright, a mid and a near-black source paint per faction
+	var sources := [Color(0.95, 0.93, 0.9), Color(0.5, 0.62, 0.7), Color(0.05, 0.05, 0.06)]
+	for fac in A4P.HULKS:
+		var worst := ""
+		for c in sources:
+			var src := StandardMaterial3D.new()
+			src.albedo_color = c
+			src.metallic = 0.0
+			var d := A4P.derelict(src, fac)
+			var y := A4P.linear_luma(d.albedo_color)
+			if y < A4P.HULK_BAND.x - 1e-3 or y > A4P.HULK_BAND.y + 1e-3:
+				worst = "luma %.3f from %s" % [y, str(c)]
+			var g := d.albedo_color
+			if fac == "deathless" and g.g > g.r * 1.15 and g.g > g.b * 1.15:
+				worst = "green %s" % str(g)
+			if fac in ["chorus", "ithar"] and g.is_equal_approx(SOOT):
+				worst = "metal soot"
+			if d.emission_enabled:
+				worst = "lights still on"
+		_report(worst == "", "%s derelicts stay in band 3 with their identity (%s)" % [fac, worst if worst != "" else "ok"])

+extends SceneTree
+# Issue 1765 (R419, Planets V2): stills of every planet look, capture only (no game default changes).
+#   board_<look>_c170: each of the five board planet looks (0 rocky, 1 terran, 3 ice, 4 volcanic, 5 barren) at the
+#     battle camera's radius and angle (camera 170, b 0.98), the planet at the board's size (map R 3, radius 50).
+#   board_<look>_close: the same planet from 70 units, low over its lit limb.
+#   backdrop_<i>: the eight backdrop planets (world_sky.gd PLANETS) as world.gd draws them, side lit.
+#   moon_<i>: the moon looks as world.gd draws them.
+# Every frame prints its body's day-side mean (linear, a geometric sphere mask, dark pixels included); an after run fails
+# if any leaves R420's band 2, 0.03 to 0.25, or the mask catches under 200 samples.
+# Runs on both sides of the change: on a checkout without world_planet.gd install_board it draws the old board path
+# (the campaign map's icon shader), so one script makes the before and the after.
+# godot --path godot --resolution 1280x720 --script res://world/planet_v2_shots.gd -- --out DIR --tag after
+# Cloud: VS_WORLD_PREVIEW=1 keeps the bakes small for the software renderer.
+const SKY := preload("res://world/world_sky.gd")
+const PL := preload("res://world/world_planet.gd")
+const BAKER := preload("res://world/world_bake.gd")
+const LOOK_KINDS := [0, 1, 3, 4, 5]
+const OLD_LOOKS := {
+	0: [Color(0.55, 0.42, 0.3), Color(0.22, 0.15, 0.1), Color(0.9, 0.65, 0.4)],
+	1: [Color(0.36, 0.42, 0.24), Color(0.07, 0.15, 0.3), Color(0.45, 0.7, 1.0)],
+	3: [Color(0.82, 0.88, 0.94), Color(0.42, 0.52, 0.62), Color(0.6, 0.8, 1.0)],
+	4: [Color(0.28, 0.2, 0.16), Color(0.08, 0.06, 0.05), Color(1.0, 0.45, 0.2)],
+	5: [Color(0.5, 0.48, 0.46), Color(0.2, 0.19, 0.19), Color(0.6, 0.62, 0.7)],
+}
+# world.gd before issue 1765: two moon palettes
+const OLD_MOONS := [
+	{"kind": 4, "a": Vector3(0.5, 0.48, 0.45), "b": Vector3(0.22, 0.21, 0.2), "c": Vector3(0.65, 0.62, 0.58)},
+	{"kind": 5, "a": Vector3(0.8, 0.84, 0.88), "b": Vector3(0.5, 0.4, 0.32), "c": Vector3(0.6, 0.75, 0.9)},
+]
+const SUN_DIR := Vector3(0.4, 0.6, 0.7)
+var out := "user://planet_v2_shots"
+var band_misses: Array = []   # R420 band 2 (RULEBOOK 3.14): each body's lit disc mean, linear, 0.03 to 0.25
+var body_c := Vector3.ZERO    # the body in the frame: centre, radius, toward its sun (for the band 2 mask)
+var body_r := 1.0
+var body_sun := Vector3.UP
+var tag := "now"
+var only := ""
+var started := 0
+var cam: Camera3D
+var stage: Node3D
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	started = Time.get_ticks_msec()
+	process_frame.connect(_run, CONNECT_ONE_SHOT)
+
+func _process(_delta: float) -> bool:
+	if Time.get_ticks_msec() - started > 2400000:
+		printerr("planet v2 shots: timeout")
+		quit(1)
+	return false
+
+func _frames(n: int) -> void:
+	for i in n:
+		await process_frame
+
+func _save(name: String) -> void:
+	await _frames(3)
+	await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw
+	var img := root.get_texture().get_image()
+	var m := _disc_mean(img)
+	var lum: float = m[0]
+	print("planet v2 shots: band2 %s lit disc mean %.3f linear over %d day-side samples" % [name, lum, int(m[1])])
+	if int(m[1]) < 200 or lum < 0.03 or lum > 0.25:
+		band_misses.append("%s %.3f (%d samples)" % [name, lum, int(m[1])])
+	var path := out.path_join("%s_%s.png" % [name, tag])
+	if preload("res://tools/picture_provenance.gd").save_png(img, path, preload("res://tools/picture_provenance.gd").capture_stage()) != OK:
+		printerr("planet v2 shots: FAILED to save ", path)
+		quit(1)
+		return
+	print("planet v2 shots: wrote ", path)
+
+# Band 2 (Artoo, PR 1776): the mask is geometric, never chosen by brightness. Each sample pixel's camera ray is hit
+# against the body's sphere; a hit on the day side (normal toward the sun past 0.15) counts however dark it renders, so
+# black terrain pulls the mean down and air, rings and space never enter. Returns [mean, samples].
+func _disc_mean(img: Image) -> Array:
+	var sum := 0.0
+	var n := 0
+	var h := int(img.get_height() * 0.8)   # above the picture stamp
+	var scale := Vector2(get_root().get_visible_rect().size) / Vector2(img.get_size())
+	for y in range(0, h, 3):
+		for x in range(0, img.get_width(), 3):
+			var sp := Vector2(x, y) * scale
+			var o := cam.project_ray_origin(sp)
+			var d := cam.project_ray_normal(sp)
+			var oc := o - body_c
+			var bq := oc.dot(d)
+			var disc := bq * bq - (oc.length_squared() - body_r * body_r)
+			if disc < 0.0:
+				continue
+			var t := -bq - sqrt(disc)
+			if t <= 0.0:
+				continue
+			var nrm := (o + d * t - body_c).normalized()
+			if nrm.dot(body_sun) < 0.15:
+				continue
+			var c := img.get_pixel(x, y).srgb_to_linear()
+			sum += 0.2126 * c.r + 0.7152 * c.g + 0.0722 * c.b
+			n += 1
+	return [sum / maxf(1.0, float(n)), n]
+
+
+func _clear() -> void:
+	for c in stage.get_children():
+		stage.remove_child(c)
+		c.queue_free()
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	root.mode = Window.MODE_WINDOWED
+	root.size = Vector2i(1280, 720)
+	var argv := OS.get_cmdline_user_args()
+	for i in argv.size():

+		if argv[i] == "--tag" and i + 1 < argv.size(): tag = argv[i + 1]
+		if argv[i] == "--only" and i + 1 < argv.size(): only = argv[i + 1]
+	DirAccess.make_dir_recursive_absolute(out)
+	var we := WorldEnvironment.new()
+	var env := Environment.new()
+	env.background_mode = Environment.BG_COLOR
+	env.background_color = Color(0.004, 0.005, 0.008)
+	env.tonemap_mode = Environment.TONE_MAPPER_AGX
+	env.tonemap_exposure = 1.0
+	env.tonemap_agx_white = 12.0
+	env.tonemap_agx_contrast = 1.25
+	we.environment = env
+	root.add_child(we)
+	# a key light along the board's sun (the old board shader was lit; the new ones light themselves from the same sun)
+	env.ambient_light_source = Environment.AMBIENT_SOURCE_COLOR
+	env.ambient_light_color = Color(0.86, 0.9, 1.0)
+	env.ambient_light_energy = 0.25
+	var key := DirectionalLight3D.new()
+	root.add_child(key)
+	key.look_at_from_position(Vector3.ZERO, -SUN_DIR, Vector3.UP)
+	key.light_energy = 1.0
+	stage = Node3D.new()
+	root.add_child(stage)
+	cam = Camera3D.new()
+	cam.fov = 45.0
+	cam.far = 20000.0
+	root.add_child(cam)
+	cam.current = true
+	BAKER.service(self)
+	var pl_script: GDScript = load("res://world/world_planet.gd")
+	var new_board := pl_script.get_script_method_list().any(func(m): return m["name"] == "install_board")
+	print("planet v2 shots: ", "new board path" if new_board else "old board path (map3d icon shader)")
+	if only == "" or only == "board":
+		for k in LOOK_KINDS:
+			await _board(k, new_board)
+	if only == "" or only == "backdrop":
+		for i in SKY.PLANETS.size():
+			await _backdrop("backdrop_%d" % i, SKY.PLANETS[i], 4100 + i, BAKER.PLANET_SIZE, 1.0)
+	if only == "" or only == "moons":
+		var W = load("res://world/world.gd")
+		var moons: Array = W.MOON_LOOKS if "MOON_LOOKS" in W.get_script_constant_map() else OLD_MOONS
+		for i in moons.size():
+			var M: Dictionary = (moons[i] as Dictionary).duplicate()
+			M["atmo"] = Vector3.ZERO
+			M["rings"] = false
+			await _backdrop("moon_%d" % i, M, int(M["kind"]) * 1000 + 3 + i * 101, BAKER.MOON_SIZE, 0.0)
+	print("planet v2 shots: done in %d s" % ((Time.get_ticks_msec() - started) / 1000))
+	if band_misses.is_empty():
+		print("planet v2 shots: band 2 PASS")
+	else:
+		print("planet v2 shots: band 2 MISS: ", ", ".join(band_misses))
+	quit(0 if band_misses.is_empty() or tag == "before" else 1)
+
+func _board(k: int, new_board: bool) -> void:
+	_clear()
+	var rad := 50.0
+	var sp := SphereMesh.new()
+	sp.radius = rad
+	sp.height = rad * 2.0
+	sp.radial_segments = 192
+	sp.rings = 96
+	var mi := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	mi.mesh = sp
+	mi.position = Vector3(0, -rad * 0.78, 0)
+	stage.add_child(mi)
+	var shell := MeshInstance3D.new()
+	var ss := SphereMesh.new()
+	ss.radius = rad * 1.03
+	ss.height = rad * 2.06
+	ss.radial_segments = 128
+	ss.rings = 64
+	shell.mesh = ss
+	shell.position = mi.position
+	stage.add_child(shell)
+	var sun := mi.position + SUN_DIR.normalized() * 100000.0
+	body_c = mi.position
+	body_r = rad
+	body_sun = SUN_DIR.normalized()
+	var seed_v := 7 + k
+	if new_board:
+		var pl_script: GDScript = load("res://world/world_planet.gd")
+		await pl_script.call("install_board", mi, shell, k, seed_v, sun)
+		for i in 600:
+			if not (mi.material_override is ShaderMaterial) or (mi.material_override as ShaderMaterial).get_shader_parameter("has_tex") != 0.0 \
+					or str(mi.get_meta("planet_code", "")) == "R01":
+				break
+			await process_frame

+		var MS = load("res://ui/campaign/map3d_shaders.gd")
+		var look: Array = OLD_LOOKS[k]
+		var pm := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		var sh := Shader.new()
+		sh.code = MS.PLANET
+		pm.shader = sh
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("kind", float(k))
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("a", look[0])
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("b", look[1])
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("atmo", look[2])
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("seed", float(posmod(seed_v, 97)) * 1.37)
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("sun_pos", sun)
+		pm.set_shader_parameter("q", 1.0)
+		mi.material_override = pm
+		var am := ShaderMaterial.new()
+		var ash := Shader.new()

+# render: world/planet_v2_shots.gd measures it and fails an after run outside 0.03 to 0.25.
+# 1. board.gd draws its planet through world_planet.gd install_board and never through the campaign map's icon shader;
+#    battle.gd waits for it behind the loading cover (silent-regression trap 1 of the World V2 plan: an asset only a
+#    shot script ever loads).
+# 2. Every board look gets a lit surface at once: rocky (0) and barren (5) then switch to the authored 8K R01 relief,
+#    rocky with its cloud layer and air, barren with neither; terran (1), ice (3) and volcanic (4) keep the baked board
+#    surface (headless has no GPU bake, so it stays the lit stand-in here; the PC shots show the baked maps).
+# 3. Two battles with different seeds see different faces of R01 (the remix turn, RULEBOOK 10.3).

+const GUARD := preload("res://tools/ci/check_guard.gd")
+const PL := preload("res://world/world_planet.gd")

+	# blue and red both clearly above green: violet, lavender, indigo

+			var shell: MeshInstance3D = pair[1]

+	while not _done:
+		await process_frame

+	_check(bsrc.contains("Time.get_ticks_msec() - planet_t0 < 20000"), "board.gd wait_planet no longer counts from the planet's own start")

+	(late[1] as Node).queue_free()

+	for k in [0, 5]:
+		var a := float(turns.get("%d|3" % k, 0.0))
+		var b := float(turns.get("%d|11" % k, 0.0))
+		_check(absf(a - b) > 0.1, "look %d: two seeds show the same face of R01 (turn %.3f and %.3f)" % [k, a, b])

+		for i in table.size():
+			var P: Dictionary = table[i]
+			for key in ["a", "b", "c", "atmo"]:
+				_check(not _purple(P[key]), "planet %d %s %s leans indigo to purple" % [i, key, str(P[key])])
+	for k in PL.BOARD_LOOKS:
+		var L: Dictionary = PL.BOARD_LOOKS[k]
+		for key in ["flat", "a", "b", "c", "atmo"]:
+			if L.has(key):
+				_check(not _purple(L[key]), "board look %d %s leans indigo to purple" % [k, key])
+	for i in WORLD.MOON_LOOKS.size():
+		for key in ["a", "b", "c"]:
+			_check(not _purple(WORLD.MOON_LOOKS[i][key]), "moon look %d %s leans indigo to purple" % [i, key])
+	_check(BAKER.MOON_SIZE.x >= 2048, "moons bake below 2K (%s)" % str(BAKER.MOON_SIZE))
+	print("planet_v2_check: %s (%d failures)" % ["PASS" if failures == 0 else "FAIL", failures])
+	quit(0 if failures == 0 else 1)

+# Issue 1361 cloud rock bench
+
+`rock_bench.gd` renders one rock group per kind (stone, iron, carbon, ice, crystal) at camera 26 or SHOT_D.
+Copy it into `godot/world/` and run it in a cloud thread in Forward+ through lavapipe:
+
+    VK_ICD_FILENAMES=/opt/lavapipe/lvp_icd.json SHOT_SHADOW=1 SHOT_D=26 xvfb-run -a -s "-screen 0 1280x720x24" \
+      godot --rendering-driver vulkan --resolution 1280x720 --path godot --script res://world/rock_bench.gd -- after OUT
+
+The "before" row loads `res://world/_before_rocks_tmp.gd`: main's world_rocks.gd with LIB_DIR pointed at a folder of
+main's rock files. Bench lights, not the game's look.gd: direction only. Do not judge rock shaders in the GL
+Compatibility renderer: a SPECULAR that varies by kind or by fragment renders the rock near black there (found here).

index 000000000..588544031
--- /dev/null
+++ b/godot/world/test/rock_scan_check.gd
@@ -0,0 +1,143 @@
+extends SceneTree
+# Issue 1361 (World V2, R419) and R420 section 6.2 item 2 (rock scan channel gate): reads every rock the game ships
+# straight from its .glb and fails on the regressions that made the five asteroid belts look alike:
+#   - a scan's fresh-face channel (COLOR_0.b, the shader's facet) crushed below a usable range (it was 0.16 to 0.27);
+#   - a low-detail or flat outlier scan (scan_06 had 14,844 triangles, scan_07 was a flat boomerang 0.43 by 1.9);
+#   - a scan file that no longer matches its scans.json hash, or a manifest count the loader does not expect;
+#   - every kind drawing on the same scan list, or the warm tan cast back on iron and carbon;
+#   - crystal clusters back to a few hundred triangles, or without their rock collar (COLOR_0.r 0) and glass (1).
+
+const GUARD := preload("res://tools/ci/check_guard.gd")
+const WR := preload("res://world/world_rocks.gd")
+const DIR := "res://world/rocks/"
+const MIN_FACET_RANGE := 0.45    # p98 minus p2 of COLOR_0.b
+const MIN_TRIS := 50000          # a full scan
+const MIN_TRIS_LO := 1500        # its far mesh
+const MIN_ASPECT := 0.3          # shortest over longest side of the box
+const CRYSTAL_TRIS := Vector2i(1500, 4000)
+
+var failures := 0
+
+
+func _init() -> void:
+	GUARD.arm(self, "rock_scan_check")
+	_run.call_deferred()
+
+
+func _check(ok: bool, message: String) -> void:
+	if not ok:
+		failures += 1
+		push_error("FAIL " + message)
+
+
+func _run() -> void:
+	var manifest = JSON.parse_string(FileAccess.get_file_as_string(DIR + "scans.json"))
+	_check(manifest is Dictionary, "scans.json does not parse")
+	if not manifest is Dictionary:
+		quit(1)
+		return
+	var rocks: Array = manifest.get("rocks", [])
+	_check(rocks.size() == WR.SCAN_COUNT, "scans.json lists %d scans, world_rocks.gd expects %d" % [rocks.size(), WR.SCAN_COUNT])
+	_check(WR.scan_names().size() == WR.SCAN_COUNT, "the loader refused the scan package (%d names)" % WR.scan_names().size())
+	var names := {}
+	for entry in rocks:
+		var nm := str(entry.name)
+		names[nm] = true
+		for f in entry.files:
+			var path: String = DIR + str(f.file)
+			var lo := str(f.file).ends_with("_lo.glb")
+			var g := _glb(path)
+			if g.is_empty():
+				_check(false, "%s does not read" % path)
+				continue
+			_check(FileAccess.get_sha256(path) == str(f.sha256), "%s does not match its scans.json hash" % f.file)
+			var tris: int = g.tris
+			_check(tris >= (MIN_TRIS_LO if lo else MIN_TRIS), "%s has %d triangles (minimum %d)" % [f.file, tris, MIN_TRIS_LO if lo else MIN_TRIS])
+			var ext: Vector3 = g.ext
+			var aspect := minf(ext.x, minf(ext.y, ext.z)) / maxf(ext.x, maxf(ext.y, ext.z))
+			_check(aspect >= MIN_ASPECT, "%s is flat: shortest side %.2f of its longest (minimum %.2f)" % [f.file, aspect, MIN_ASPECT])
+			var b: PackedFloat32Array = g.colour_b
+			_check(b.size() > 0, "%s has no COLOR_0" % f.file)
+			if b.size() > 0:
+				b.sort()
+				var spread := b[int(b.size() * 0.98)] - b[int(b.size() * 0.02)]
+				_check(spread >= MIN_FACET_RANGE, "%s COLOR_0.b spans %.2f (p2 to p98, minimum %.2f): the facet channel is crushed" % [f.file, spread, MIN_FACET_RANGE])
+				print("%s: %d triangles, aspect %.2f, facet spread %.2f" % [f.file, tris, aspect, spread])
+	# each kind draws on its own scans, all of them in the package
+	var pools := {}
+	for kind in WR.KINDS:
+		var pool: Array = WR.names_for(kind)
+		_check(pool.size() >= 3, "%s draws on only %d scans" % [kind, pool.size()])
+		for nm in pool:
+			_check(names.has(nm), "%s draws on %s, which is not in scans.json" % [kind, nm])
+		pools[str(pool)] = true
+	_check(pools.size() >= 4, "only %d different scan pools across the five kinds" % pools.size())
+	var src := FileAccess.get_file_as_string("res://world/world_rocks.gd")
+	_check(not src.contains("if (kind != 3 && kind != 4) { a *= vec3(1.12, 1.0, 0.84); }"), "the warm tan cast is back on iron and carbon")
+	# crystal clusters
+	var crystals: Array = WR.lib().get("crystals", [])
+	_check(crystals.size() >= 3, "rocks.json lists %d crystal clusters" % crystals.size())
+	for nm in crystals:
+		var g := _glb(DIR + str(nm) + ".glb")
+		if g.is_empty():
+			_check(false, "%s does not read" % nm)
+			continue
+		var tris: int = g.tris
+		_check(tris >= CRYSTAL_TRIS.x and tris <= CRYSTAL_TRIS.y, "%s has %d triangles (want %d to %d)" % [nm, tris, CRYSTAL_TRIS.x, CRYSTAL_TRIS.y])
+		var r: PackedFloat32Array = g.colour_r
+		var glass := 0
+		for v in r:
+			if v > 0.5: glass += 1
+		_check(glass > 0 and glass < r.size(), "%s needs both glass (COLOR_0.r 1) and its rock collar (0): %d of %d glass" % [nm, glass, r.size()])
+		_check(absf(g.lo_y) < 0.02 and absf(g.hi_y - 1.0) < 0.02, "%s leaves the base 0, tip 1 frame (%.2f to %.2f)" % [nm, g.lo_y, g.hi_y])
+		print("%s: %d triangles, %d of %d vertices glass" % [nm, tris, glass, r.size()])
+	print("rock_scan_check: %d failures" % failures)
+	quit(1 if failures > 0 else 0)
+
+
+# The first primitive of a .glb: triangle count, box, COLOR_0 r and b as 0 to 1 floats.
+func _glb(path: String) -> Dictionary:
+	if not FileAccess.file_exists(path):
+		return {}
+	var bytes := FileAccess.get_file_as_bytes(path)
+	if bytes.size() < 28 or bytes.decode_u32(0) != 0x46546c67:
+		return {}
+	var jlen := bytes.decode_u32(12)
+	var doc = JSON.parse_string(bytes.slice(20, 20 + jlen).get_string_from_utf8())
+	if not doc is Dictionary:
+		return {}
+	var bin_at := 20 + jlen + 8
+	var prim: Dictionary = doc.meshes[0].primitives[0]
+	var pos: Dictionary = doc.accessors[int(prim.attributes.POSITION)]
+	var out := {"tris": int(doc.accessors[int(prim.indices)].count) / 3,
+		"ext": Vector3(pos.max[0] - pos.min[0], pos.max[1] - pos.min[1], pos.max[2] - pos.min[2]),
+		"lo_y": float(pos.min[1]), "hi_y": float(pos.max[1]), "colour_r": PackedFloat32Array(), "colour_b": PackedFloat32Array()}
+	if not prim.attributes.has("COLOR_0"):
+		return out
+	var acc: Dictionary = doc.accessors[int(prim.attributes.COLOR_0)]
+	var view: Dictionary = doc.bufferViews[int(acc.bufferView)]
+	var comps := 4 if str(acc.type) == "VEC4" else 3
+	var ctype := int(acc.componentType)
+	var size := {5126: 4, 5123: 2, 5121: 1}.get(ctype, 0) as int
+	if size == 0:
+		return out
+	var stride := int(view.get("byteStride", size * comps))
+	var start := bin_at + int(view.get("byteOffset", 0)) + int(acc.get("byteOffset", 0))
+	var r := PackedFloat32Array()
+	var b := PackedFloat32Array()
+	r.resize(int(acc.count))
+	b.resize(int(acc.count))
+	for i in int(acc.count):
+		var at := start + i * stride
+		r[i] = _comp(bytes, at, ctype)
+		b[i] = _comp(bytes, at + 2 * size, ctype)
+	out.colour_r = r
+	out.colour_b = b
+	return out
+
+
+func _comp(bytes: PackedByteArray, at: int, ctype: int) -> float:
+	match ctype:
+		5126: return bytes.decode_float(at)
+		5123: return bytes.decode_u16(at) / 65535.0
+		_: return bytes.decode_u8(at) / 255.0
diff --git a/godot/world/tools/crystal_kit.py b/godot/world/tools/crystal_kit.py
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..f343a05b3
--- /dev/null
+++ b/godot/world/tools/crystal_kit.py
@@ -0,0 +1,137 @@
+"""Issue 1361 (World V2, R419): faceted multi-crystal clusters for crystal fields (godot/world/rocks/crystal_NN.glb).
+
+Replaces rockgen.py's 216-tri clusters. Each cluster is a rough mineral host collar with 8 to 14 hexagonal quartz/beryl
+prisms bursting out of it at varied height and lean, with pointed (sometimes skewed) terminations and a thin bevel on
+every edge so the facets catch the sun. Same frame as before: base on y = 0, tallest tip at y = 1, about 1 across, so
+world.gd's placement and scales are unchanged.
+
+Vertex colour (CRYSTAL_SHADER in world_rocks.gd):
+  R  1 = crystal, 0 = host rock collar
+  G  height along the prism (0 at its root, 1 at its tip) times the prism's share of the hero's length
+  B  a per-prism value (inner depth and brightness variety)
+  A  1
+
+Blender 4.5 (the PC's LTS; in a cloud thread the pip bpy 4.5.4 wheel). Run:
+  blender -b -P crystal_kit.py -- OUT_DIR [count]      or      python crystal_kit.py OUT_DIR [count]   (bpy wheel)
+"""
+import sys, math, random
+from pathlib import Path
+import bpy, bmesh
+from mathutils import Vector, Matrix, noise
+
+SEEDS = [1361, 2361, 3361, 4361]
+
+
+def args():
+    a = sys.argv[sys.argv.index('--') + 1:] if '--' in sys.argv else sys.argv[1:]
+    return Path(a[0]), int(a[1]) if len(a) > 1 else len(SEEDS)
+
+
+def clear():
+    bpy.ops.wm.read_factory_settings(use_empty=True)
+
+
+def build(seed, out):
+    rnd = random.Random(seed)
+    clear()
+    # host collar: a flattened, noise-broken rock the prisms grow out of
+    bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_ico_sphere_add(subdivisions=4, radius=1.0)
+    collar = bpy.context.object

index 000000000..d7eb84a9a
--- /dev/null
+++ b/godot/world/tools/scan_facet.py
@@ -0,0 +1,121 @@
+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+"""Issue 1361 (World V2, R419): re-bake the fresh-face channel (COLOR_0.b, the shader's `facet`) on the scanned rocks.
+
+planet369_remix.py wrote 1 - roughness into COLOR_0.b. The scans are rough everywhere, so the channel came out crushed
+(mean 0.09 to 0.24, range under 0.3) and every shader branch that reads it went quiet: no metal on iron, specks of ice,
+no crystal veins. This script replaces it with the scan's own ridge and edge convexity at two scales, ranked per mesh so
+every scan spans 0 to 1 with the same spread (mean about 0.4, like rockgen.py's procedural rocks).
+
+The far mesh (_lo) takes the mean value of the full mesh's vertices in its own clustering cell (planet369_remix.py
+cluster(), grid 13), so the near and far rock carry the same pattern. Only the colour bytes change; the files keep their
+size and layout. Run: python3 scan_facet.py ROCK_DIR scan_00 scan_01 ...   (numpy only; prints the new sha256 and stats)
+"""
+import sys, json, struct, hashlib
+from pathlib import Path
+import numpy as np
+
+GRID = 13          # planet369_remix.py cluster() grid for the _lo meshes
+CURVE = 1.5        # rank ** CURVE: mean about 0.4, a few bright ridges at 1
+
+
+def read(path):
+    b = path.read_bytes()
+    jl = struct.unpack('<I', b[12:16])[0]
+    doc = json.loads(b[20:20 + jl])
+    bin_start = 20 + jl + 8
+    prim = doc['meshes'][0]['primitives'][0]
+
+    def acc(i):
+        a = doc['accessors'][i]
+        v = doc['bufferViews'][a['bufferView']]
+        n = {'SCALAR': 1, 'VEC3': 3, 'VEC4': 4}[a['type']]
+        dt = {5126: '<f4', 5125: '<u4'}[a['componentType']]
+        off = bin_start + v.get('byteOffset', 0) + a.get('byteOffset', 0)
+        assert 'byteStride' not in v
+        return np.frombuffer(b, dt, a['count'] * n, off).reshape(-1, n), off
+
+    P, _ = acc(prim['attributes']['POSITION'])
+    N, _ = acc(prim['attributes']['NORMAL'])
+    C, coff = acc(prim['attributes']['COLOR_0'])
+    I, _ = acc(prim['indices'])
+    return b, P.astype(np.float64), N.astype(np.float64), C.copy(), coff, I.reshape(-1, 3)
+
+
+def smooth(val, ii, n, steps):
+    # one-ring averaging through the triangle edges, `steps` times
+    a = np.concatenate([ii[:, 0], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 0]])
+    c = np.concatenate([ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 0], ii[:, 0], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2]])
+    deg = np.bincount(a, minlength=n).astype(np.float64) + 1.0
+    for _ in range(steps):
+        val = (np.bincount(a, weights=val[c], minlength=n) + val) / deg
+    return val
+
+
+def convexity(P, N, ii):
+    n = len(P)
+    a = np.concatenate([ii[:, 0], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 0]])
+    c = np.concatenate([ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2], ii[:, 0], ii[:, 0], ii[:, 1], ii[:, 2]])
+    deg = np.maximum(np.bincount(a, minlength=n), 1).astype(np.float64)
+    mean = np.stack([np.bincount(a, weights=P[c, k], minlength=n) for k in range(3)], 1) / deg[:, None]
+    edge = np.linalg.norm(P[ii[:, 0]] - P[ii[:, 1]], axis=1).mean()
+    # neighbours' mean below the vertex along its normal: a ridge or an edge (positive), a hollow (negative)
+    cv = np.einsum('ij,ij->i', P - mean, N) / max(edge, 1e-9)
+    fine = smooth(cv, ii, n, 2)
+    broad = smooth(cv, ii, n, 12)
+    return fine * 0.55 + broad / max(np.std(broad), 1e-9) * np.std(fine) * 0.45
+
+
+def ranked(v):
+    r = np.empty(len(v))
+    r[np.argsort(v, kind='stable')] = np.linspace(0.0, 1.0, len(v))
+    return r ** CURVE
+
+
+def cell_keys(P):
+    k = np.floor((P + 1.0) * GRID).astype(np.int64)
+    return (k[:, 0] * 4096 + k[:, 1]) * 4096 + k[:, 2]
+
+
+def write(path, b, coff, C):
+    out = bytearray(b)
+    blob = C.astype('<f4').tobytes()
+    out[coff:coff + len(blob)] = blob
+    path.write_bytes(bytes(out))
+    return hashlib.sha256(bytes(out)).hexdigest()
+
+
+def main():
+    root = Path(sys.argv[1])
+    for name in sys.argv[2:]:
+        b, P, N, C, coff, ii = read(root / f'{name}.glb')
+        # weld split vertices (UV seams) by position, so the one-ring sees across seams
+        _, first, weld = np.unique(np.round(P * 1e5).astype(np.int64), axis=0, return_index=True, return_inverse=True)
+        weld = weld.reshape(-1)
+        wn = np.zeros((len(first), 3))
+        np.add.at(wn, weld, N)
+        wn /= np.maximum(np.linalg.norm(wn, axis=1, keepdims=True), 1e-9)
+        facet = ranked(convexity(P[first], wn, weld[ii]))[weld]
+        C[:, 2] = facet
+        sha = write(root / f'{name}.glb', b, coff, C)
+        print(name, 'b mean %.2f p2 %.2f p98 %.2f' % (facet.mean(), np.percentile(facet, 2), np.percentile(facet, 98)), sha)
+        # far mesh: the cell mean of the full mesh
+        keys = cell_keys(P)
+        uk, inv = np.unique(keys, return_inverse=True)
+        cell_mean = np.bincount(inv, weights=facet) / np.bincount(inv)
+        lb, LP, _, LC, lcoff, _ = read(root / f'{name}_lo.glb')
+        lk = cell_keys(LP)
+        pos = np.searchsorted(uk, lk)
+        pos = np.clip(pos, 0, len(uk) - 1)
+        hit = uk[pos] == lk
+        lf = np.where(hit, cell_mean[pos], np.nan)
+        if (~hit).any():
+            # a far vertex outside every cell: nearest full vertex
+            for j in np.nonzero(~hit)[0]:
+                lf[j] = facet[np.argmin(np.sum((P - LP[j]) ** 2, axis=1))]
+        LC[:, 2] = lf
+        lsha = write(root / f'{name}_lo.glb', lb, lcoff, LC)
+        print(name + '_lo', 'b mean %.2f p2 %.2f p98 %.2f misses %d' % (lf.mean(), np.percentile(lf, 2), np.percentile(lf, 98), (~hit).sum()), lsha)
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    main()

 `wound_kind` in faction_looks.json selects metal (0), living tissue (1), crystal
 (2), or Eclipse machine wounds (3). Living hulls use spores and ichor; crystal
 uses dust and vapour with no flame; Eclipse uses dead panels, violet circuits,
 slow rim arcs, coolant, dark smoke and violet plasma. Repair seals every break.
 
+**Wounds V2 (R416, issue 1741; off unless `VS_WOUNDS_V2=1` or the setting `rendering/effects/wounds_v2`, read by
+`fx/fx_wounds_flag.gd` `v2()`).** Each faction's `wound` profile in faction_looks.json (kind 0 Sunward to 5 Eclipse,
+rim_style, scorch_col, rim_metal, interior_lift, interior_accent, interior_pattern, interior_rough, soot_weight,
+wreck_soot) drives every wound shader. On an authored-interior hull a section opens a real cutout from stage 2 (0.026 L,
+0.038 L at stage 3, 0.052 L at stage 4; a second one at stage 3 and up on medium hulls), and a heavy hit (torpedo, lance,
+null lance, star, gauss exit, weight 3+) on a section under 80% HP opens one where it struck; at most 6 per ship and 2 per
+section, clear of turrets and bay doors (`fx_ship._clear_spot`). Every cutout goes through
+`fx_breach.validate_footprint` (8 rays at 0.85 R: shrink to 0.75 R and 0.55 R, slide toward the plating, else a small
+surface mark) and `place_hole` (faction rim, plate thickness `clamp(Dt * 0.14, 0.008 L, 0.24 R)`; a plate thinner than
+0.4 R chips with `thin_shear` instead of opening). Overlays skip faces turned more than about 70 degrees from the hit and
+sit in a tighter slab; the hull shader's cut skips walls at right angles to it. `fx_breach.dress` puts the faction's own
+3D dressing inside each mouth (beams and cables, bone ribs and tendons, crystal shards, obsidian truss and violet bus),
+`inside_lights` adds at most 2 soft lights per ship in `interior_accent`, and the built interior takes the shared
+`fx_shaders.INTERIOR` shader (`fx_hull.interior_material_v2`) once a mouth is open; `fx.wreck_interior(source, faction)`
+hands the same shader to the wreck pieces. `fx_breach.open_mouths(s)` lists a ship's open mouths ({c, n, R}, hull
+frame) for vents and embers. With V2 on, prism, star and null lance hits leave `S_PRISM`, `S_STAR` and `S_NLANCE` marks.
+Proof: `fx/test/wounds_v2_check.gd`, look-bench rows `bench/look_moments_wounds_v2.json` (cameras 170 and 26).
+
 **Refinement (r5).** Coarse geometry (kit plates and big AI hull panels are a few large triangles) is split locally before a mark is cut: edges longer than the mark needs, near the mark, are split (conforming on both sides, every vertex attribute interpolated, so the vertex format and materials stay), so a hole or crater smaller than a plate is still cut and dented. The overlay skin covers every triangle that reaches into the mark, not only those whose centre does.
 
 **Halo (r5).** Every weapon mark also lays a wide halo in its own signature, at least `HALO_MIN` world units (fx_breach.gd; 0.75 for a lance cut up to 2.1 for a torpedo crater), so it reads from the battle camera 170 units away, where the mark's own detail is a few pixels: soot round shells, torpedo craters and boarding pits; soot with temper colours along a lance cut; dark blue glass freckles with a faint lasting sheen round plasma; a grey rash round flak; green-black etch round acid; a blue-black field round ion burns; bright scraped metal round a ram; a pale spalled field round a gauss exit.
 
 **Weapon marks (R43).** Every hull hit adds a mark entry at the hit point (fx_breach.marks_for, by look and weight), built by the same rebuild as the breaches: the mark changes the hull geometry where its kind needs it and lays an overlay skin with its surface (char, molten metal cooling white to red to black, light blue plasma slag, spall, acid etching, electrical burns, scraped metal).

+# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Wounds V2 (R416, issue 1741; VS_WOUNDS_V2=1 only)
+
+const FOOT_RAYS := 8
+const FOOT_MIN := 6          # rays that must land on solid plating facing the hit (75% support)
+const V2_HOLES_SHIP := 6     # open cutouts at once per ship ...
+const V2_HOLES_SEC := 2      # ... and per hull section
+const V2_HOLE_L := [0.026, 0.038, 0.052]   # cutout radius as a share of the ship's length at stage 2, 3 and 4
+

+static func v2_on() -> bool:
+	return WOUNDS.v2()
+
+
+# The faction's V2 wound profile (faction_looks.json "wound"); {} for an unknown faction.
+static func wound_of(faction: String) -> Dictionary:
+	var w = FL.of(faction).get("wound", {})
+	return w if w is Dictionary else {}
+
+
+static func wound_col(w: Dictionary, key: String, fb: Color) -> Color:
+	var v = w.get(key)
+	if v is Array and (v as Array).size() >= 3:
+		return Color(float(v[0]), float(v[1]), float(v[2]))
+	return fb

+static func _basis(n: Vector3) -> Array:
+	var t1 := n.cross(Vector3.UP if absf(n.y) < 0.9 else Vector3.RIGHT).normalized()
+	return [t1, n.cross(t1)]
+
+
+# [rays that land on plating facing the hit inside the depth band, the sum of their hit points]
+static func _foot_count(hull, c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float) -> Array:
+	var tb := _basis(n)
+	var band := maxf(R * 0.45, hull.L * 0.025)
+	var ok := 0
+	var sum := Vector3.ZERO
+	for k in FOOT_RAYS:
+		var an := TAU * k / FOOT_RAYS
+		var o: Vector3 = c + ((tb[0] as Vector3) * cos(an) + (tb[1] as Vector3) * sin(an)) * (0.85 * R) + n * (R * 0.9)
+		var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(o, -n)
+		if h.is_empty():
+			continue
+		var hp: Vector3 = h["p"]
+		if absf((hp - c).dot(n)) < band and (h["n"] as Vector3).dot(n) > 0.30:
+			ok += 1
+			sum += hp
+	return [ok, sum]
+
+
+# The plate's thickness under (c, n): the median of the centre and four half-radius inward rays (1e9: no far face).
+static func thickness(hull, c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float) -> float:
+	if hull == null:
+		return 1e9
+	var tb := _basis(n)
+	var ds: Array = []
+	for k in 5:
+		var o := c
+		if k > 0:
+			var an := TAU * (k - 1) / 4.0
+			var h0: Dictionary = hull.ray(c + ((tb[0] as Vector3) * cos(an) + (tb[1] as Vector3) * sin(an)) * (0.5 * R) + n * (R * 0.9), -n)
+			if h0.is_empty() or absf(((h0["p"] as Vector3) - c).dot(n)) > R * 0.6:
+				continue
+			o = h0["p"]
+		var far: Dictionary = hull.ray(o - n * (R * 0.03), -n)
+		ds.append(1e9 if far.is_empty() else ((far["p"] as Vector3) - o).length() + R * 0.03)
+	if ds.is_empty():
+		return 1e9
+	ds.sort()
+	return float(ds[ds.size() / 2])

+# R416 4.1: before any cutout or heavy mark of radius R at (c, n) goes on, eight rays round 0.85 R check there is plating
+# under it. Short of six, the mark shrinks (0.75 R, then 0.55 R) and slides toward the plating the rays did find; still
+# short (or under 1.5% of the ship's length), ok is false and the caller makes a small surface mark instead. thin: the
+# plate is thinner than 0.4 R (a shade ring arc, a fin, a strut), so it chips instead of opening into a cavity.
+static func validate_footprint(hull, c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float) -> Dictionary:
+	var out := {"ok": false, "c": c, "n": n, "R": R, "valid": 0, "thin": false, "Dt": 1e9}
+	if hull == null:
+		out["ok"] = true
+		return out
+	var cc := c
+	var nn := n
+	for k in [1.0, 0.75, 0.55]:
+		var r: float = R * float(k)
+		if r < hull.L * 0.015:
+			break
+		var res := _foot_count(hull, cc, nn, r)
+		out["valid"] = int(res[0])
+		if int(res[0]) >= FOOT_MIN:
+			out["ok"] = true
+			out["c"] = cc
+			out["n"] = nn
+			out["R"] = r
+			break
+		if int(res[0]) > 0:
+			var avg: Vector3 = (res[1] as Vector3) / float(res[0])
+			var h: Dictionary = hull.ray(avg + nn * r * 0.9, -nn)
+			if not h.is_empty() and (h["n"] as Vector3).dot(nn) > 0.3:
+				cc = h["p"]
+				nn = h["n"]
+	if bool(out["ok"]):
+		var Dt := thickness(hull, out["c"], out["n"], out["R"])
+		out["Dt"] = Dt
+		out["thin"] = Dt < maxf(float(out["R"]) * 0.4, hull.L * 0.018)
+	return out

+# A V2 cutout for this faction at (c, n): the footprint check first, then a hole with the faction's rim (curled or ragged
+# petals, square sheared panels, chitin, straight glass panes, stepped obsidian) and a real plate thickness on its cut
+# edge; a thin plate chips (thin_shear); no support at all gives a small surface mark (fallback_style) instead.
+static func place_hole(hull, c: Vector3, n: Vector3, R: float, seed_v: float, faction: String, style := S_BREACH, fallback_style := S_DENT) -> Ent:
+	var w := wound_of(faction)
+	var kind := int(w.get("kind", 0))
+	var fp := validate_footprint(hull, c, n, R)
+	if not bool(fp["ok"]):
+		var e0 := crater(c, n, maxf(R * 0.45, hull.L * 0.008 if hull != null else R * 0.45), R * 0.08, seed_v, fallback_style)
+		e0.v2 = kind
+		return e0
+	var cc: Vector3 = fp["c"]
+	var nn: Vector3 = fp["n"]
+	var r: float = fp["R"]
+	var Dt: float = fp["Dt"]
+	var rim := String(w.get("rim_style", "curled"))
+	var bend := 1.0
+	var buckle := 0.14
+	match rim:
+		"ragged":
+			bend = 1.3; buckle = 0.2
+		"modular", "stepped", "facet":
+			bend = 0.0; buckle = 0.02
+		"chitin":
+			bend = 0.35; buckle = 0.035
+	var e := hole(hull, cc, nn, r, bend, buckle, seed_v, style)
+	e.v2 = kind
+	match rim:
+		"modular", "stepped":
+			e.square = true
+			e.k = 1.0
+		"facet":
+			e.facets = 6 + int(e.p[6] / TAU * 3.0)
+			e.k = 1.0
+		"ragged":
+			e.k = 7.0
+		"chitin":
+			e.w = r * 0.22
+	var L: float = hull.L if hull != null else r * 20.0
+	e.th = minf(maxf(Dt * 0.14, L * 0.008), r * 0.24) if Dt < 1e8 else r * 0.24
+	if bool(fp["thin"]):
+		# R416 4.1: a thin structure chips its outer layer over a frame strip; nothing cuts through to open space
+		e.thin_shear = true
+		e.cut = Dt * 0.55
+		e.D = Dt * 0.6
+		e.th = Dt * 0.3
+		e.walls = false
+		e.conduits = false
+	return e
+

+# Every open V2 mouth on a ship, in its hull frame (for the live wisps and embers of 1587 blowouts, the M3 thread).
+static func open_mouths(s) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var ents: Array = []
+	for i in 3:
+		ents.append_array(s._ents[i])
+	ents.append_array(s._marks)
+	for x in ents:
+		var e: Ent = x
+		if e.has_cut() and not e.thin_shear:
+			out.append({"c": e.c, "n": e.n, "R": e.R})
+	return out
+

+# The V2 cutout caps over the final entry list a rebuild draws (Artoo on PR 1755: the stage path and the hit path each
+# checked their own list, so their sum could pass the caps): in list order (the stage cutouts first, then the marks the
+# cap keeps), a V2 cutout past V2_HOLES_SHIP on the ship or V2_HOLES_SEC in its section is left out. Every other entry
+# stays. With V2 off no entry has v2 >= 0, so the list comes back unchanged.
+static func cap_holes(ents: Array) -> Array:
+	var out: Array = []
+	var total := 0
+	var per := {}
+	for x in ents:
+		var e: Ent = x
+		if e.has_cut() and e.v2 >= 0:
+			if total >= V2_HOLES_SHIP or int(per.get(e.sec, 0)) >= V2_HOLES_SEC:
+				# past the caps: a sealed dent where it would have opened, never nothing (audit, PR 1755)
+				var d := crater(e.c, e.n, e.R * 0.6, e.R * 0.12, e.seed_v, S_DENT)
+				d.v2 = e.v2
+				d.sec = e.sec
+				d.t0 = e.t0
+				out.append(d)
+				continue
+			total += 1
+			per[e.sec] = int(per.get(e.sec, 0)) + 1
+		out.append(e)
+	return out
+

+static func count_holes(ents: Array, sec := -1) -> int:
+	var k := 0
+	for x in ents:
+		var e: Ent = x
+		if e.has_cut() and e.v2 >= 0 and (sec < 0 or e.sec == sec):
+			k += 1
+	return k

+# A straight beam (box section) from a to b, w wide and h tall, its height along up.
+static func _beam(pt: Part, a: Vector3, b: Vector3, w: float, h: float, up: Vector3, col: Color) -> void:
+	var ax := (b - a).normalized()
+	var u := (up - ax * up.dot(ax)).normalized()
+	var v := ax.cross(u)
+	var cs := [u * h * 0.5 + v * w * 0.5, -u * h * 0.5 + v * w * 0.5, -u * h * 0.5 - v * w * 0.5, u * h * 0.5 - v * w * 0.5]

+	for k in 4:
+		var c0: Vector3 = cs[k]
+		var c1: Vector3 = cs[(k + 1) % 4]
+		var nm: Vector3 = ((c0 + c1) * 0.5).normalized()
+		_quad(pt, a + c0, b + c0, b + c1, a + c1, nm, col)
+	_quad(pt, b + cs[0], b + cs[1], b + cs[2], b + cs[3], ax, col)
+	_quad(pt, a + cs[0], a + cs[1], a + cs[2], a + cs[3], -ax, col)

+static func _box_faces(size: Vector3, at := Vector3.ZERO) -> PackedVector3Array:
+	var bm := BoxMesh.new()

+	var idx: PackedInt32Array = arr[Mesh.ARRAY_INDEX]
+	var out := PackedVector3Array()
+	for i in idx:
+		out.append(v[i] + at)
+	return out

+
+func _hull_of(faces: PackedVector3Array, L: float):
+	var h = HULL.new()
+	var tm := TriangleMesh.new()
+	tm.create_from_faces(faces)
+	h.tm = tm
+	h.L = L
+	return h

+# the recipe (the stage 4 build, or the stage 5 painted blend with the interior trim maps on). Three section views, each a clip
+# plane through the ship, so the rooms, girders, frames and trim read in place:
+#   section   the side, cut at the centreline (the near half removed)
+#   plan      from above, cut at mid height
+#   close     a three-quarter view from port and above, cut by a plane through the ship's middle, zoomed on the midships third
+# The light comes in through the cut (the hull and room shells cast no shadow; the modeled pieces do). Writes
+# <code>_cut_section.png, <code>_cut_plan.png, <code>_cut_close.png and <code>_cutaway.jpg (the three on one sheet, 1280 wide,
+# no taller than 720, the code name, stage and revision on it; RULEBOOK 1.2).
+# usage (Blender or the bpy module):  python cutaway.py BLEND OUT_DIR "<title>" [stage=cloud direction check] [samples=24] [res=1]
+import os, math
+import bpy
+from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
+
+args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if '=' not in a]
+opts = dict(a.split('=', 1) for a in sys.argv[1:] if '=' in a)
+BLEND, OUT, TITLE = args[-3:]
+STAGE = opts.get('stage', 'cloud direction check')
+SAMPLES = int(opts.get('samples', 24)); RES = float(opts.get('res', 1))
+os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
+bpy.ops.wm.open_mainfile(filepath=BLEND)
+sc = bpy.context.scene
+for o in list(sc.objects):
+    if o.type in ('CAMERA', 'LIGHT'):
+        bpy.data.objects.remove(o, do_unlink=True)
+meshes = [o for o in sc.objects if o.type == 'MESH' and not o.hide_render and not o.get('proxy')]
+inside = [o for o in sc.objects if o.type == 'MESH' and (o.get('role') == 'interior' or o.get('inside'))]
+for o in inside:
+    o.hide_render = False
