+# Interior Kit V2 (issue 1743, R416 Layer 3; RULEBOOK 5.4). Runs inside Blender, from Kit.finish(), after the hull, the parts and
+# every inside the sheet placed are built.
+#
+# Every sheet's insides (K.room, K.deck, K.bulkhead, K.organ_room, K.hoop, K.septum and a sheet's own in_deck_ / in_bh_ objects)
+# stay what they were: the room's enclosure, the deck slab, the bulkhead plate. This pass adds the modeled interior around them,
+# read from what the sheet built, so every sheet upgrades on its next build without a line changed:
+#   rooms by kind     core/ecore reactor vessel with containment rings, cooling headers and core slits; engroom turbine drums,
+#                     flanges, manifolds and stern feeds; magazine tube racks in retaining frames; hrack/machinery equipment rack
+#                     rows and conduit risers; hangar gantry rails, roof truss ribs and wall ribs; every other kind (bridge, hcorr,
+#                     crew, darkdeck, archive, hold, gallery) ribbed bays with consoles, archive stacks or crates along the walls;
+#   decks             longitudinal and transverse under-deck girders and edge flanges, following the deck's own footprint;
+#   bulkheads         a hull-hugging collar, two stanchions, a cross beam and a framed pass-through arch on both faces;
+#   the Chorus        vascular ridges and sac lobes on organs, glands, guts and vats; knobbed bone cross-struts between hoops;
+#                     fibrous ridges along each septum (no metal anywhere: factions.md, the Chorus Never list);
+#   the Eclipse       trusses, never ribs (factions.md, the Eclipse Never list): its bays take truss braces and archive stacks.
+# The Glasswrights' insides are modeled in their own kit (tools/blender/kits/ithar/hull.py insides(): prism nodes on the frames,
+# collared lens rings on the light cores); this pass only gives them UVs.
+#
+# A piece furnishing a room is dropped whole unless it lies inside the room's own box (the sheet placed the room; what is inside
+# it is hidden wherever the room is). Every other piece (girders under a deck, a bulkhead's frame, Chorus ridges, lobes and
+# struts) is dropped whole when any of its points sits outside the hull or closer to the hull's skin than MARGIN (R99,
+# surface_check.py: no room pixel seen from outside; issue 1291: a room reaching the skin shows through it). Long pieces are cut into short segments, so the game's death cut
+# tears them with the plating (R226, fx/test/death_seam_check.gd; a long sliver face sends a liner to the wrong piece).
+# Last, every inside object gets box-projected UVs at one texel density (TILE of the ship's length per tile), which the faction's
+# shared interior trim maps (tools/blender/kits/shared/interior_trim.py) tile over at paint (stage 5), and each is marked
+# interior_kit = 2 (the export records it; check_export.py holds a V2 export to its trim maps).
+import math, random
+import bpy
+import bmesh
+from mathutils import Vector
+from mathutils.bvhtree import BVHTree
+
+VERSION = 2
+TILE = 0.055          # one trim tile spans this fraction of the ship's length (21-unit H10: 1.16 units)
+MARGIN = 0.006        # of the ship's length: the closest a point added outside a room may sit to the hull's skin
+SEG = 0.03            # of the ship's length: the longest segment of a long piece (death seam tearing)
+CHORUS_ORGANS = ('organ', 'gut', 'gland', 'brood', 'vat', 'ganglion')
+THIN_KINDS = ('hemerg',)   # light strips the sheet builds as rooms: nothing to furnish
+
+
+class Mesh:
+    """verts and faces of one added object, with a smooth flag per face"""
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.V = []; self.F = []; self.S = []
+
+    def add(self, V, F, smooth=False):
+        o = len(self.V); self.V += [tuple(v) for v in V]; self.F += [tuple(i + o for i in f) for f in F]; self.S += [smooth] * len(F)
+
+    def extend(self, other):
+        o = len(self.V); self.V += other.V; self.F += [tuple(i + o for i in f) for f in other.F]; self.S += other.S
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ primitives
+def box(c, h, seg=None):
+    """an axis box at centre c with half extents h, cut into segments along its longest axis (no face longer than seg)"""
+    ax = max(range(3), key=lambda i: h[i]); n = 1 if not seg else max(1, int(math.ceil(2 * h[ax] / seg)))
+    o1, o2 = [i for i in range(3) if i != ax]
+    corners = [(-1, -1), (1, -1), (1, 1), (-1, 1)]
+    V = []
+    for k in range(n + 1):
+        t = -1 + 2 * k / n
+        for a, b in corners:
+            p = [0, 0, 0]; p[ax] = c[ax] + t * h[ax]; p[o1] = c[o1] + a * h[o1]; p[o2] = c[o2] + b * h[o2]; V.append(p)
+    F = []
+    for k in range(n):
+        for j in range(4):
+            a, b = k * 4 + j, k * 4 + (j + 1) % 4
+            F.append((a, b, b + 4, a + 4))
+    F.append((3, 2, 1, 0)); F.append(tuple(n * 4 + j for j in range(4)))
+    return V, F
+
+
+def tube(p0, p1, r, n=8, seg=None, cap=True, r1=None):
+    """a capped cylinder from p0 to p1 (r at p0, r1 at p1), cut into rings no farther apart than seg"""
+    p0, p1 = Vector(p0), Vector(p1); d = p1 - p0; L = d.length
+    if L < 1e-6:
+        return [], []
+    ax = d / L; u = ax.orthogonal().normalized(); w = ax.cross(u); r1 = r if r1 is None else r1
+    m = 1 if not seg else max(1, int(math.ceil(L / seg)))
+    V = []
+    for k in range(m + 1):
+        t = k / m; p = p0 + d * t; rr = r + (r1 - r) * t
+        V += [p + (u * math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / n) + w * math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / n)) * rr for i in range(n)]
+    F = [(k * n + i, k * n + (i + 1) % n, (k + 1) * n + (i + 1) % n, (k + 1) * n + i) for k in range(m) for i in range(n)]
+    if cap:
+        F.append(tuple(range(n))[::-1]); F.append(tuple(range(m * n, (m + 1) * n)))
+    return V, F
+
+
+def ring(c, axis, r, w, t, n=16):
+    """a square-section ring (a containment ring, a flange, a lens collar): radius r to r + t, width w along axis"""
+    c = Vector(c); ax = Vector(axis).normalized(); u = ax.orthogonal().normalized(); v = ax.cross(u)
+    V = []
+    for s in (-w / 2, w / 2):
+        for rr in (r, r + t):
+            V += [c + ax * s + (u * math.cos(2 * math.pi * i / n) + v * math.sin(2 * math.pi * i / n)) * rr for i in range(n)]
+    F = []
+    for i in range(n):
+        j = (i + 1) % n
+        F += [(n + i, n + j, 3 * n + j, 3 * n + i), (j, i, 2 * n + i, 2 * n + j), (i, j, n + j, n + i), (3 * n + i, 3 * n + j, 2 * n + j, 2 * n + i)]
+    return V, F
+
+
+def lump(c, radii, seed=0, nu=10, nv=6, amp=0.12):
+    """a small lumpy ellipsoid (a sac lobe, a bone knob)"""
+    rnd = random.Random(seed); ph = [rnd.uniform(0, 6.3) for _ in range(3)]
+    V = [(c[0], c[1], c[2] - radii[2])]
+    for j in range(1, nv):
+        th = math.pi * j / nv - math.pi / 2
+        for i in range(nu):
+            a = 2 * math.pi * i / nu
+            k = 1 + amp * math.sin(3 * a + ph[0]) * math.cos(2 * th + ph[1]) + amp * 0.5 * math.sin(5 * a + 2 * th + ph[2])
+            V.append((c[0] + radii[0] * math.cos(th) * math.cos(a) * k, c[1] + radii[1] * math.cos(th) * math.sin(a) * k, c[2] + radii[2] * math.sin(th) * k))
+    V.append((c[0], c[1], c[2] + radii[2]))
+    F = [(0, 1 + (i + 1) % nu, 1 + i) for i in range(nu)]
+    for j in range(nv - 2):
+        for i in range(nu):
+            a = 1 + j * nu + i; b = 1 + j * nu + (i + 1) % nu; F.append((a, b, b + nu, a + nu))
+    top = len(V) - 1; o = 1 + (nv - 2) * nu
+    F += [(o + i, o + (i + 1) % nu, top) for i in range(nu)]
+    return V, F
+
+
+def path_tube(pts, r, n=6):
+    """a tube along a polyline (veins, ridges, fibres), capped"""
+    pts = [Vector(p) for p in pts]
+    V = []
+    for i, p in enumerate(pts):
+        d = (pts[min(i + 1, len(pts) - 1)] - pts[max(0, i - 1)]).normalized()
+        q = d.cross(Vector((0, 0, 1)))
+        if q.length < 0.1:
+            q = d.cross(Vector((0, 1, 0)))
+        q.normalize(); w = d.cross(q).normalized()
+        rr = r[i] if isinstance(r, (list, tuple)) else r
+        V += [p + (q * math.cos(2 * math.pi * j / n) + w * math.sin(2 * math.pi * j / n)) * rr for j in range(n)]
+    F = [(i * n + j, i * n + (j + 1) % n, (i + 1) * n + (j + 1) % n, (i + 1) * n + j) for i in range(len(pts) - 1) for j in range(n)]
+    F += [tuple(range(n))[::-1], tuple(range((len(pts) - 1) * n, len(pts) * n))]
+    return V, F
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ the pass
+class Dresser:
+    def __init__(self, K, faction):
+        self.K = K; self.fac = faction; self.L = K.length
+        self.seg = SEG * K.length; self.margin = MARGIN * K.length
+        self.kept = 0; self.dropped = 0; self.added = {}; self.why = {}; self.room_box = None
+        self.tree = self._outer_tree()
+
+    def _outer_tree(self):
+        """one BVH over everything that is not an inside (the hull with its shell, the plates, the parts), world space"""
+        dg = bpy.context.evaluated_depsgraph_get(); V = []; F = []
+        for ob in self.K.coll.all_objects:
+            if ob.type != 'MESH' or ob.get('inside'):
+                continue
+            ev = ob.evaluated_get(dg); me = ev.to_mesh(); mw = ob.matrix_world; o = len(V)
+            V += [mw @ v.co for v in me.vertices]; F += [tuple(i + o for i in p.vertices) for p in me.polygons]
+            ev.to_mesh_clear()
+        return BVHTree.FromPolygons(V, F) if F else None
+
+    def inside_hull(self, p):
+        """p sits inside the outer surfaces (a hit straight up, down, port and starboard) and at least MARGIN from them"""
+        if self.tree is None:
+            return True
+        p = Vector(p)
+        loc, _n, _i, d = self.tree.find_nearest(p)
+        if loc is not None and d < self.margin:
+            self.why['skin'] = self.why.get('skin', 0) + 1
+            return False
+        for dv in ((0, 0, 1), (0, 0, -1), (0, 1, 0), (0, -1, 0)):
+            if self.tree.ray_cast(p, Vector(dv))[0] is None:
+                self.why['open'] = self.why.get('open', 0) + 1
+                return False
+        return True
+
+    def piece(self, out, VF, smooth=False):
+        """add one piece to out when every point of it (and its middle) is inside the hull and off its skin; a piece built
+        inside a room's own box (self.room_box) is held to that box instead: the sheet placed the room, so a piece within it is
+        hidden wherever the room is (R99), and a room close under the skin keeps its furniture"""
+        V, F = VF
+        if not V:
+            return False
+        if self.room_box is not None:
+            lo, hi = self.room_box; e = 1e-5
+            if all(lo[i] - e <= v[i] <= hi[i] + e for v in V for i in range(3)):
+                out.add(V, F, smooth); self.kept += 1; return True
+            self.dropped += 1; self.why['room'] = self.why.get('room', 0) + 1
+            return False
+        test = list(V)
+        if len(V) <= 64:
+            c = Vector((sum(v[0] for v in V) / len(V), sum(v[1] for v in V) / len(V), sum(v[2] for v in V) / len(V)))
+            test.append(c)
+        if all(self.inside_hull(v) for v in test):
+            out.add(V, F, smooth); self.kept += 1; return True
+        self.dropped += 1
+        return False
+
+    def emit(self, src, out, mat):
+        if not out.F:
+            return None
+        name = 'in_v2_%s_%s' % (src.name[3:] if src.name.startswith('in_') else src.name, mat)
+        ob = self.K._obj(name, out.V, out.F, mat, inside=True)
+        for p, s in zip(ob.data.polygons, out.S):
+            p.use_smooth = s
+        ob['grp'] = src.get('grp', 'hull'); ob['interior_kit'] = VERSION; ob['dress_of'] = src.name
+        self.added[mat] = self.added.get(mat, 0) + len(out.F)
+        return ob
+
+    # ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- rooms
+    def room(self, ob, kind):
+        try:
+            self._room(ob, kind)
+        finally:
+            self.room_box = None
+
+    def _room(self, ob, kind):
+        lo, hi = bounds(ob)
+        self.room_box = (lo.copy(), hi.copy())
+        dims = hi - lo
+        if min(dims) < 0.012 * self.L or kind in THIN_KINDS:
+            return
+        m = 0.03 * min(dims)        # stay off the room's own walls
+        lo = lo + Vector((m, m, m)); hi = hi - Vector((m, m, m))
+        frame_mat = 'frame' if self.fac != 'chorus' else 'bonefr'
+        mach = Mesh(); furn = Mesh(); glow = Mesh()
+        if kind in ('core', 'ecore'):
+            self.reactor(lo, hi, mach, glow)
+            made = self.emit(ob, mach, 'machinery'); self.emit(ob, glow, kind)
+            if made is not None and glow.F:
+                # the core's light now shows through the vessel's slits (and the vessel when it breaks open); the room around it
+                # stops glowing all over, which washed the whole compartment out to white in the cutaway
+                ob.data.materials[0] = made.data.materials[0]
+            return
+        if kind == 'engroom':
+            self.turbines(lo, hi, mach, furn)
+        elif kind == 'magazine':
+            self.racks_tubes(lo, hi, furn, mach)
+        elif kind in ('hrack', 'machinery'):
+            self.equipment(lo, hi, furn, mach)
+        elif kind == 'hangar':
+            self.hangar(lo, hi, mach)
+        else:
+            self.bay(lo, hi, kind, furn, mach)
+        self.emit(ob, mach, frame_mat); self.emit(ob, furn, kind if kind != 'engroom' else 'machinery')
+
+    def reactor(self, lo, hi, mach, glow):
+        dims = hi - lo; c = (lo + hi) / 2
+        ax = 0 if dims.x >= dims.z else 2
+        o = [i for i in range(3) if i != ax]
+        half = min(dims[o[0]], dims[o[1]]) / 2; r = 0.62 * half; Lh = dims[ax] / 2 * 0.9
+        a = c.copy(); a[ax] -= Lh; b = c.copy(); b[ax] += Lh
+        e = Vector((0, 0, 0)); e[ax] = 1
+        ia = a + e * (0.12 * Lh); ib = b - e * (0.12 * Lh)
+        self.piece(mach, tube(ia, ib, r, 16, self.seg), True)
+        self.piece(mach, tube(a, ia, 0.6 * r, 16, None, True, r), True)                # domed ends (frustums)
+        self.piece(mach, tube(ib, b, r, 16, None, True, 0.6 * r), True)
+        nr = 4
+        for k in range(nr):
+            p = ia + (ib - ia) * ((k + 0.5) / nr)
+            self.piece(mach, ring(p, e, r, 0.07 * Lh, 0.12 * r, 20))
+        u = Vector((0, 0, 0)); u[o[0]] = 1; v = Vector((0, 0, 0)); v[o[1]] = 1
+        for k in range(4):                                                              # cooling headers
+            ang = math.pi / 4 + k * math.pi / 2; off = (u * math.cos(ang) + v * math.sin(ang)) * (1.28 * r)
+            self.piece(mach, tube(ia + off, ib + off, 0.08 * r, 8, self.seg), True)
+        for k in range(nr - 1):                                                         # recessed core slits between the rings
+            p0 = ia + (ib - ia) * ((k + 0.5) / nr) + e * (0.05 * Lh); p1 = ia + (ib - ia) * ((k + 1.5) / nr) - e * (0.05 * Lh)
+            for j in range(4):
+                ang = j * math.pi / 2; nrm = u * math.cos(ang) + v * math.sin(ang); tg = nrm.cross(e)
+                cc = (p0 + p1) / 2 + nrm * (0.985 * r)
+                V = [cc + e * s1 * ((p1 - p0).length / 2) + tg * s2 * 0.07 * r + nrm * s3 * 0.03 * r
+                     for s1 in (-1, 1) for s2 in (-1, 1) for s3 in (-1, 1)]
+                F = [(0, 1, 3, 2), (4, 6, 7, 5), (0, 4, 5, 1), (2, 3, 7, 6), (0, 2, 6, 4), (1, 5, 7, 3)]
+                self.piece(glow, (V, F))
+
+    def turbines(self, lo, hi, mach, furn):
+        dims = hi - lo; c = (lo + hi) / 2
+        two = dims.y > 1.6 * dims.z
+        ys = (c.y - dims.y / 4, c.y + dims.y / 4) if two else (c.y,)
+        r = 0.42 * min(dims.z, dims.y / len(ys)) * 0.95
+        x0 = lo.x + 0.08 * dims.x; x1 = hi.x - 0.18 * dims.x
+        for y in ys:
+            zc = lo.z + r * 1.05
+            self.piece(mach, tube((x0, y, zc), (x1, y, zc), r, 16, self.seg), True)
+            for k in range(5):
+                x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (k + 0.5) / 5
+                self.piece(mach, ring((x, y, zc), (1, 0, 0), r, 0.04 * dims.x, 0.1 * r, 18))
+            for s in (-1, 1):                                                           # stern feed conduits to the aft wall
+                self.piece(furn, tube((x0, y + s * 0.45 * r, zc), (lo.x, y + s * 0.45 * r, zc), 0.12 * r, 8), True)
+        zt = hi.z - 0.08 * dims.z                                                       # the overhead manifold
+        for s in (-1, 1):
+            self.piece(furn, tube((lo.x, c.y + s * 0.3 * dims.y, zt), (hi.x, c.y + s * 0.3 * dims.y, zt), 0.04 * dims.z, 8, self.seg), True)
+        for y in ys:
+            for k in range(3):
+                x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * (k + 0.5) / 3
+                self.piece(furn, tube((x, y, lo.z + 2.05 * r), (x, y, zt), 0.035 * dims.z, 8), True)
+
+    def racks_tubes(self, lo, hi, furn, mach):
+        dims = hi - lo; c = (lo + hi) / 2
+        r = max(0.01 * self.L, 0.1 * min(dims.y, dims.z))
+        ny = max(1, min(8, int(dims.y / (2.6 * r)))); nz = max(1, min(4, int(dims.z / (2.6 * r))))
+        r = min(r, dims.y / ny / 2.6, dims.z / nz / 2.6)
+        x0 = lo.x + 0.06 * dims.x; x1 = hi.x - 0.06 * dims.x
+        for i in range(ny):
+            for j in range(nz):
+                y = lo.y + dims.y * (i + 0.5) / ny; z = lo.z + dims.z * (j + 0.5) / nz
+                self.piece(furn, tube((x0, y, z), (x1, y, z), r, 10, self.seg), True)
+        bar = 0.25 * r
+        for k in range(3):                                                              # retaining frames
+            x = x0 + (x1 - x0) * k / 2
+            for (yc, zc, hy, hz) in ((c.y, lo.z + bar, dims.y / 2, bar), (c.y, hi.z - bar, dims.y / 2, bar),
+                                     (lo.y + bar, c.z, bar, dims.z / 2), (hi.y - bar, c.z, bar, dims.z / 2)):
+                self.piece(mach, box((x, yc, zc), (bar, hy, hz)))
+
+    def equipment(self, lo, hi, furn, mach):
+        dims = hi - lo; c = (lo + hi) / 2
+        rnd = random.Random(int(abs(c.x * 1000 + c.y * 37)))
+        junky = self.fac == 'hullbreakers'
+        aisle = 0.3 * dims.y
+        rows = [(lo.y, c.y - aisle / 2), (c.y + aisle / 2, hi.y)] if dims.y > 0.8 * dims.z else [(lo.y, hi.y)]
+        n = max(2, min(10, int(dims.x / (0.5 * dims.z + 1e-6))))
+        for (ya, yb) in rows:
+            for k in range(n):
+                xa = lo.x + dims.x * k / n; xb = lo.x + dims.x * (k + 1) / n; gap = 0.06 * (xb - xa)
+                h = dims.z * (0.82 if not junky else rnd.uniform(0.45, 0.85))
+                d = (yb - ya) * (0.92 if not junky else rnd.uniform(0.6, 0.92))
+                yc = ya + d / 2 if ya > c.y - 1e-6 or len(rows) == 1 else yb - d / 2
+                self.piece(furn, box(((xa + xb) / 2, yc, lo.z + h / 2), ((xb - xa) / 2 - gap, d / 2, h / 2)))
+                # the rack's face: a recessed panel band and a vent block on top
+                self.piece(furn, box(((xa + xb) / 2, yc, lo.z + h * 0.55), ((xb - xa) / 2 - 2 * gap, d / 2 + 0.02 * dims.y, 0.08 * h)))
+            for k in range(n + 1):                                                      # conduit risers between racks
+                x = lo.x + dims.x * k / n
+                y = (ya + yb) / 2
+                if lo.x + 0.03 * dims.x < x < hi.x - 0.03 * dims.x:
+                    self.piece(mach, tube((x, y, lo.z), (x, y, hi.z), 0.025 * dims.z + 0.002 * self.L, 6), True)
+
+    def hangar(self, lo, hi, mach):
+        dims = hi - lo; c = (lo + hi) / 2
+        b = 0.05 * min(dims.y, dims.z)
+        for s in (-1, 1):                                                               # gantry rails
+            self.piece(mach, box((c.x, c.y + s * 0.32 * dims.y, hi.z - b), (dims.x / 2, b, b), self.seg))
+        n = max(3, int(dims.x / (0.6 * dims.z)))
+        for k in range(n + 1):                                                          # roof truss ribs and wall ribs

+# Shared interior trim maps (issue 1743, R416 Layer 3; RULEBOOK 5.4). Shared plumbing only, no look of its own: every colour,
+# panel size, strip, vein and facet setting comes from the faction's stack (INSIDE_TRIM in tools/blender/kits/<faction>/stack.py,
+# RULEBOOK 4.5). Paint (stage 5) calls trim_material() from each faction's inside_material() when the ship's insides carry the
+# Interior Kit V2 UVs (tools/blender/build_sheets/interior_kit.py).
+#
+# One tiling set per faction, made here from numbers (nothing painted by hand, nothing projected, seeded so every bake makes the
+# same pixels): albedo (sRGB), ORM (occlusion, roughness, metal; linear) and a detail normal (OpenGL, linear), plus an emission
+# map where the faction lights its insides (corridor strips, ember conduits, blue emergency lines, violet-white bus rails, bile in
+# the veins). The albedo is a DETAIL map whose every channel averages 0.5; each room's material scales it by the room's own
+# colour (baseColorFactor = 2 x the room's albedo), so one set of maps serves every room of the ship and a broken ship's spaces
+# are still not all one colour. The images are packed into the blend, so stage 7 finds them; export7 writes them once per ship
+# (shared by every interior material, tools/recipe/export7.py "authored trim maps may be shared").
+# Styles: 'panels' (metal factions: a panel grid with seams, bolts, grilles, conduits and light strips; rust only where the stack
+# asks, so soot and rust stay on the Hullbreakers), 'flesh' (the Chorus: cells, raised veins, pores; wet, no metal), 'glass'
+# (the Glasswrights: annealed facets and fine lines; no metal, no soot).
+import hashlib, json, math
+import numpy as np
+
+SIZE = 1024
+
+
+def _noise(n, sigma, rng):
+    """tileable smooth noise in 0..1 (white noise low-passed in the frequency domain)"""
+    f = np.fft.fft2(rng.standard_normal((n, n)))
+    k = np.fft.fftfreq(n)[:, None] ** 2 + np.fft.fftfreq(n)[None, :] ** 2
+    a = np.real(np.fft.ifft2(f * np.exp(-k * (2 * math.pi * sigma) ** 2 / 2)))
+    return (a - a.min()) / (a.max() - a.min() + 1e-9)
+
+
+def _blur(a, sigma):
+    k = np.fft.fftfreq(a.shape[0])[:, None] ** 2 + np.fft.fftfreq(a.shape[1])[None, :] ** 2
+    return np.real(np.fft.ifft2(np.fft.fft2(a) * np.exp(-k * (2 * math.pi * sigma) ** 2 / 2)))
+
+
+def _normal(h, strength):
+    dx = (np.roll(h, -1, 1) - np.roll(h, 1, 1)) * 0.5 * strength
+    dy = (np.roll(h, -1, 0) - np.roll(h, 1, 0)) * 0.5 * strength
+    n = np.stack([-dx, -dy, np.ones_like(h)], -1)
+    return n / np.linalg.norm(n, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
+
+
+def _panels(n, spec, rng):
+    """the metal styles: height, a per-pixel panel value (0..1), a light-strip mask and a rust mask"""
+    G = int(spec.get('panel', 8)); cs = n / G
+    Y, X = np.mgrid[0:n, 0:n].astype(float)
+    ci, cj = np.minimum((X // cs).astype(int), G - 1), np.minimum((Y // cs).astype(int), G - 1); fx, fy = X - ci * cs, Y - cj * cs
+    split = rng.integers(0, 3, (G, G)) if spec.get('split', 0.5) > 0 else np.zeros((G, G), int)
+    split = np.where(rng.random((G, G)) < spec.get('split', 0.5), split, 0)
+    sp = split[cj, ci]
+    w = np.where(sp == 1, cs / 2, cs).astype(float); hgt = np.where(sp == 2, cs / 2, cs).astype(float)
+    lx = np.where(sp == 1, fx % (cs / 2), fx); ly = np.where(sp == 2, fy % (cs / 2), fy)
+    sub = np.where(sp == 1, fx // (cs / 2), np.where(sp == 2, fy // (cs / 2), 0)).astype(int).clip(0, 1)
+    pid = (cj * G + ci) * 2 + sub
+    pr = rng.random(G * G * 2)[pid]                                         # one value per panel
+    edge = np.minimum(np.minimum(lx, w - 1 - lx), np.minimum(ly, hgt - 1 - ly))
+    sw = max(2.0, cs * 0.025)
+    h = np.clip(edge / sw, 0, 1) ** 0.7 * (0.75 + 0.25 * pr)               # seams: grooves at every panel edge
+    # bolts in the panel corners
+    b = cs * 0.07; br = max(1.6, cs * 0.018)
+    for cx in (b, None):
+        for cy in (b, None):
+            px = lx - (b if cx else w - 1 - b); py = ly - (b if cy else hgt - 1 - b)
+            d = np.sqrt(px ** 2 + py ** 2)
+            h = h + np.clip(1 - d / br, 0, 1) ** 0.5 * 0.35 * (edge > sw)
+    # grilles: some panels carry slats
+    g = (rng.random(G * G * 2)[pid] < spec.get('grille', 0.2)) & (edge > cs * 0.12)
+    period = max(4.0, cs * 0.06)
+    h = h - g * 0.35 * (np.sin(2 * math.pi * ly / period) > 0.2)
+    # conduits: a few full-width pipes along panel rows
+    strip = np.zeros((n, n))
+    rows = spec.get('conduit_rows', 2)
+    for k in range(rows):
+        yc = (k + 0.5) * n / rows + cs * 0.5; r = cs * 0.09
+        d = np.abs(((Y - yc + n / 2) % n) - n / 2)
+        h = np.where(d < r, np.maximum(h, 0.6 + 0.6 * np.sqrt(np.clip(1 - (d / r) ** 2, 0, 1))), h)
+    # light strips: thin recessed lines along every few panel rows
+    st = spec.get('strip')
+    if st:
+        every = int(st.get('every', 4)); thick = max(2.0, cs * 0.03)
+        for k in range(0, G, every):
+            yc = k * cs + cs * 0.5
+            d = np.abs(((Y - yc + n / 2) % n) - n / 2)
+            on = d < thick

+    rust = np.zeros((n, n))
+    if spec.get('rust', 0) > 0:
+        rn = _noise(n, n * 0.05, rng) * 0.7 + _noise(n, n * 0.012, rng) * 0.3
+        rust = np.clip((rn - (1 - spec['rust'])) / 0.12, 0, 1)
+    return h, pr, strip, rust
+
+
+def _cells(n, count, rng, warp=None):
+    """tileable Worley distances (F1, F2) and the nearest cell's id; warp: (dx, dy) pixel offsets bending the cells (flesh)"""
+    pts = rng.random((count, 2)) * n
+    Y, X = np.mgrid[0:n, 0:n].astype(np.float32)
+    if warp is not None:
+        X = (X + warp[0]) % n; Y = (Y + warp[1]) % n
+    F1 = np.full((n, n), 1e9, np.float32); F2 = np.full((n, n), 1e9, np.float32); idn = np.zeros((n, n), np.int32)
+    for i, (px, py) in enumerate(pts):
+        dx = np.abs(X - px); dx = np.minimum(dx, n - dx); dy = np.abs(Y - py); dy = np.minimum(dy, n - dy)
+        d = np.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
+        closer = d < F1
+        F2 = np.where(closer, F1, np.minimum(F2, d)); idn = np.where(closer, i, idn); F1 = np.where(closer, d, F1)
+    return F1, F2, idn
+
+
+def maps(spec, n=SIZE):
+    """the faction's set: dict(base (n, n, 3) sRGB 0..1, orm (n, n, 3) linear, normal (n, n, 3) encoded, emission (n, n, 3) sRGB
+    or None). Row 0 is the bottom of the image (Blender's pixel order)."""
+    rng = np.random.default_rng(int(spec.get('seed', 1743)))
+    style = spec.get('style', 'panels')
+    tint = np.array(spec.get('tones', ((1.0, 1.0, 1.0),)), float)          # detail tones (relative), averaged to 0.5 below
+    em = None
+    if style == 'panels':
+        h, pr, strip, rust = _panels(n, spec, rng)
+        grime = _noise(n, n * 0.02, rng)
+        cav = np.clip(_blur(h, 3.0) - h, 0, None) + np.clip(_blur(h, 10.0) - h, 0, None) * 0.5
+        ao = np.clip(1 - 3.0 * cav, 0.25, 1)
+        tone = tint[np.minimum((pr * len(tint)).astype(int), len(tint) - 1)]
+        var = spec.get('var', 0.12)
+        alb = tone * (1 + var * (pr[..., None] - 0.5) * 2) * (0.75 + 0.25 * ao[..., None]) * (1 - spec.get('grime', 0.2) * grime[..., None])
+        if spec.get('rust', 0) > 0:
+            alb = alb * (1 - rust[..., None]) + np.array(spec.get('rust_tone', (1.6, 0.75, 0.45)))[None, None] * rust[..., None] * 0.6
+        rlo, rhi = spec.get('rough', (0.45, 0.8))
+        rough = rlo + (rhi - rlo) * (0.6 * pr + 0.4 * grime) + 0.15 * rust
+        metal = np.full((n, n), spec.get('metal', 0.6)) * (1 - 0.8 * rust)
+        if spec.get('strip'):
+            s = spec['strip']; em = np.array(s['rgb'], float)[None, None] * strip[..., None]
+            alb = alb * (1 - strip[..., None]) + strip[..., None] * 0.9
+        nrm = _normal(h, spec.get('relief', 6.0))
+    elif style == 'flesh':
+        wa = spec.get('warp', 0.04) * n
+        warp = ((_noise(n, n * 0.03, rng) - 0.5) * 2 * wa, (_noise(n, n * 0.03, rng) - 0.5) * 2 * wa)
+        F1, F2, idn = _cells(n, int(spec.get('cells', 90)), rng, warp)         # bent cells: tissue, never tiles
+        border = np.clip(1 - (F2 - F1) / spec.get('vein_w', 6.0), 0, 1)            # veins on the cell borders
+        dome = np.clip(1 - F1 / (F1.max() * 0.8), 0, 1) ** 0.6 * 0.6 + 0.4 * _noise(n, n * 0.008, rng)
+        pr = rng.random(int(spec.get('cells', 90)))[idn]
+        fine = _noise(n, 3.0, rng)
+        h = 0.55 * dome + 0.5 * border ** 1.5 + 0.08 * fine
+        pores = (fine > 0.82) & (border < 0.2)
+        h = np.where(pores, h - 0.25, h)
+        cav = np.clip(_blur(h, 4.0) - h, 0, None)
+        ao = np.clip(1 - 3.0 * cav, 0.3, 1)
+        flesh = np.array(spec.get('flesh_tone', (1.0, 0.95, 0.7)), float); vein = np.array(spec.get('vein_tone', (0.7, 0.18, 0.12)), float)
+        alb = flesh[None, None] * (0.8 + 0.4 * pr[..., None]) * (1 - border[..., None] ** 2) + vein[None, None] * border[..., None] ** 2
+        alb = alb * (0.7 + 0.3 * ao[..., None]) * np.where(pores, 0.35, 1.0)[..., None]
+        rlo, rhi = spec.get('rough', (0.28, 0.5))
+        rough = rlo + (rhi - rlo) * (1 - dome) + 0.1 * pores
+        metal = np.zeros((n, n))
+        if spec.get('glow'):
+            g = spec['glow']; mask = (border > 0.85) & (_noise(n, n * 0.04, rng) > 1 - g.get('share', 0.25))
+            em = np.array(g['rgb'], float)[None, None] * mask[..., None] * border[..., None]
+        nrm = _normal(h, spec.get('relief', 5.0))
+    else:                                                                     # glass
+        F1, F2, idn = _cells(n, int(spec.get('cells', 60)), rng)
+        k = int(spec.get('cells', 60))
+        tilt = rng.normal(0, spec.get('facet', 0.18), (k, 2))[idn]
+        line = np.clip(1 - (F2 - F1) / spec.get('line_w', 2.5), 0, 1)
+        nrm = np.stack([tilt[..., 0], tilt[..., 1], np.ones((n, n))], -1)
+        nrm = nrm / np.linalg.norm(nrm, axis=-1, keepdims=True)
+        pr = rng.random(k)[idn]
+        alb = np.ones((n, n, 3)) * (0.85 + 0.3 * pr[..., None]) * (1 - 0.35 * line[..., None])
+        ao = np.clip(1 - 0.25 * line, 0, 1)
+        rlo, rhi = spec.get('rough', (0.08, 0.3))
+        rough = rlo + (rhi - rlo) * (0.5 * pr + 0.5 * line)
+        metal = np.zeros((n, n))
+        if spec.get('glow'):
+            g = spec['glow']; em = np.array(g['rgb'], float)[None, None] * (line[..., None] ** 2) * g.get('share', 0.4)
+    alb = np.clip(alb, 0, None); alb = alb / (alb.reshape(-1, 3).mean(0) + 1e-6) * 0.5     # the detail averages 0.5 per channel
+    alb = np.clip(alb, 0, 1)
+    srgb = lambda c: np.where(c <= 0.0031308, 12.92 * c, 1.055 * np.clip(c, 0, None) ** (1 / 2.4) - 0.055)
+    out = dict(base=srgb(alb), orm=np.stack([ao, np.clip(rough, 0.04, 1), np.clip(metal, 0, 1)], -1),
+               normal=nrm * 0.5 + 0.5, emission=None if em is None else srgb(np.clip(em, 0, 1)))
+    return out
+
+
+def _key(fac, spec):
+    return hashlib.sha1(json.dumps([fac, spec], sort_keys=True, default=str).encode()).hexdigest()[:8]
+
+
+_CACHE = {}
+
+
+def images(fac, spec, n=SIZE):
+    """the faction's packed Blender images (made once per blend: a second call returns the same images)"""
+    import bpy
+    key = _key(fac, spec)
+    pre = 'trim_%s_%s' % (fac, key)
+    if bpy.data.images.get(pre + '_base') is not None:
+        return {k: bpy.data.images.get('%s_%s' % (pre, k)) for k in ('base', 'orm', 'normal', 'emission')}
+    m = maps(spec, n); out = {}
+    for k, a in m.items():
+        if a is None:
+            out[k] = None; continue
+        im = bpy.data.images.new('%s_%s' % (pre, k), n, n, alpha=False)
+        im.colorspace_settings.name = 'sRGB' if k in ('base', 'emission') else 'Non-Color'
+        px = np.concatenate([a.astype(np.float32), np.ones((n, n, 1), np.float32)], -1)
+        im.pixels.foreach_set(px.ravel()); im.update()
+        im.file_format = 'PNG'; im.pack()

+    return out
+
+
+def trim_material(name, fac, spec, albedo, emission=None, strip_strength=None):
+    """one interior material: the faction's trim maps, scaled by the room's albedo (linear rgb, each at most 0.5), with its own
+    constant emission (the core: rgb, strength) or else the faction's strip emission map"""
+    import bpy
+    ims = images(fac, spec)
+    m = bpy.data.materials.new(name); m.use_nodes = True; nt = m.node_tree; N = nt.nodes; Lk = nt.links
+    b = N['Principled BSDF']

+    mix = N.new('ShaderNodeMix'); mix.data_type = 'RGBA'; mix.blend_type = 'MULTIPLY'; mix.inputs['Factor'].default_value = 1.0
+    mix.inputs['B'].default_value = (*[min(1.0, 2.0 * c) for c in albedo], 1)
+    Lk.new(tb.outputs['Color'], mix.inputs['A']); Lk.new(mix.outputs['Result'], b.inputs['Base Color'])
+    to = N.new('ShaderNodeTexImage'); to.image = ims['orm']
+    sep = N.new('ShaderNodeSeparateColor')
+    Lk.new(to.outputs['Color'], sep.inputs['Color']); Lk.new(sep.outputs['Green'], b.inputs['Roughness']); Lk.new(sep.outputs['Blue'], b.inputs['Metallic'])
+    # occlusion: the glTF exporter reads the red channel from its own output group
+    grp = bpy.data.node_groups.get('glTF Material Output') or bpy.data.node_groups.new('glTF Material Output', 'ShaderNodeTree')
+    if not grp.interface.items_tree:
+        grp.interface.new_socket('Occlusion', in_out='INPUT', socket_type='NodeSocketFloat')
+    g = N.new('ShaderNodeGroup'); g.node_tree = grp
+    Lk.new(sep.outputs['Red'], g.inputs['Occlusion'])
+    tn = N.new('ShaderNodeTexImage'); tn.image = ims['normal']
+    nm = N.new('ShaderNodeNormalMap')
+    Lk.new(tn.outputs['Color'], nm.inputs['Color']); Lk.new(nm.outputs['Normal'], b.inputs['Normal'])
+    if emission is not None:
+        b.inputs['Emission Color'].default_value = (*emission[0], 1); b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = emission[1]
+    elif ims['emission'] is not None:

+        Lk.new(te.outputs['Color'], b.inputs['Emission Color']); b.inputs['Emission Strength'].default_value = strip_strength or spec.get('strip', spec.get('glow', {})).get('strength', 1.0)
+    m['ps_inside'] = 1; m['interior_trim'] = fac

+
+
+def upgrade(flat, fac, spec, lift, base=None, flat_base=None):
+    """the V2 material for a faction's flat inside material (the legacy one its inside_material() just made): the same room
+    colour, lifted by the stack's INSIDE_LIFT (each channel at most 0.5), and its own light (the core) kept; the flat one is removed.
+    base: the stack's own interior colour for the trim (the Directorate's white corridors), carrying the room's tint over
+    flat_base (the liner colour the flat one was made from) instead of the lift"""
+    import bpy
